name: 34_light_sweep_prism.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5
-- @title Light Sweep Prism
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Light sweep prism. A tilted band of light sweeps across the text; each
part it touches lifts toward the camera, flashes white and settles into
a spectral color, as if the light refracted through the glyphs.
]]

local kSweepPeriod = 5.0 -- seconds for one full out-and-back sweep
local kSweepAngle = math.rad(20.0) -- tilt of the sweep direction from horizontal
local kBandWidth = 0.09 -- gaussian half-width of the light band, world units
local kSweepReach = 0.9 -- world-space distance the band travels past center
local kLiftHeight = 0.25 -- part.z at full flash
local kBaseHue = 0.55 -- resting hue the prism colors are spread around

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local sweepX = math.cos(kSweepAngle)
    local sweepY = math.sin(kSweepAngle)
    local bandPosition = mt.lerp(-kSweepReach, kSweepReach, mt.pingpong(ctx.time, kSweepPeriod))

    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry
        local worldX = (geometry.canvas_center_x - 0.5) * aspect
        local worldY = geometry.canvas_center_y - 0.5

        -- Signed distance along the sweep direction: negative once the
        -- band has passed this part.
        local signedDistance = (worldX * sweepX + worldY * sweepY) - bandPosition

        local flash = mt.falloff(signedDistance, kBandWidth)
        local lit = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.1, -signedDistance)

        -- Spectral color: hue fans out with position so neighboring
        -- parts refract into neighboring wavelengths.
        local prismHue = mt.wrap(kBaseHue + worldY * 0.35 + worldX * 0.12, 0.0, 1.0)
        local prismColor = mt.color.from_hsv(prismHue, 0.65, 1.0, 1.0)
        local dimColor = { r = 0.32, g = 0.33, b = 0.38, a = 1.0 }
        local white = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }

        local settled = mt.color.lerp(dimColor, prismColor, lit)

        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(settled, white, flash)
        part.z = flash * kLiftHeight
        part.scale = 1.0 + flash * 0.15
    end
end
description:
Light sweep prism. A tilted band of light sweeps across the text; each
part it touches lifts toward the camera, flashes white and settles into
a spectral color, as if the light refracted through the glyphs.
title: Light Sweep Prism
author: Mug

name: 35_focus_flow.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5
-- @title Focus Flow
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Focus-sweep telop. The line never moves; instead a magnifying focus
runs through it twice, swelling each character it crosses and pushing
the neighbors aside -- revealing on the first pass, wiping on the second.
]]

local kSecondsPerCharacter = 0.09 -- sweep rate; smaller = snappier
local kSweepPadding = 1.5 -- the sweep starts/ends this many characters off each end
local kMaxSweepClipFraction = 0.4 -- one sweep may occupy at most this clip fraction
local kFocusBoost = 0.45 -- extra scale at the focus center
local kFocusSigma = 1.4 -- gaussian width of the focus, in characters
local kRetypesetTracking = 0.012 -- spacing handed to mt.layout.reflow
local kRevealSoftness = 1.2 -- how tightly appearance hugs the passing focus
local kWiggleDegrees = 1.1 -- micro rotation drift keeping the hold organic
local kWiggleSpeed = 0.8 -- wiggle time scale
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kRestFill = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 } -- resting color of the line
local kFocusFill = { r = 1.0, g = 0.78, b = 0.25, a = 1.0 } -- accent while the focus crosses

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local remainingSeconds = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local clipLength = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = ctx.char_count

    -- Sweep pacing: fixed real seconds per character, compressed only
    -- when two sweeps would not fit in the clip.
    local sweepSpan = characterCount + 2.0 * kSweepPadding
    local secondsPerCharacter =
        math.min(kSecondsPerCharacter, clipLength * kMaxSweepClipFraction / sweepSpan)
    local sweepDuration = sweepSpan * secondsPerCharacter

    -- Focus positions in index space. The intro sweep starts at clip
    -- start; the outro sweep ends exactly at clip end.
    local introFocus = -kSweepPadding + ctx.time / secondsPerCharacter
    local outroFocus = -kSweepPadding + (sweepDuration - remainingSeconds) / secondsPerCharacter

    -- Pass 1: swell, reveal, and wipe. Scale must be final before the
    -- reflow so retypeset sees the true character widths.
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local introDistance = index - introFocus
        local outroDistance = index - outroFocus
        local focus = math.max(
            mt.falloff(introDistance, kFocusSigma),
            mt.falloff(outroDistance, kFocusSigma))

        -- A character exists from the moment the intro focus reaches it
        -- until the outro focus has passed over it.
        local revealed = mt.smoothstep(-kRevealSoftness, 0.0, introFocus - index)
        local wiped = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kRevealSoftness, outroFocus - index)

        character.scale = 1.0 + kFocusBoost * mt.ease.out_quad(focus)
        character.opacity = revealed * (1.0 - wiped)
        character.rotation = mt.wiggle(ctx.time * kWiggleSpeed, 2.5, kWiggleDegrees, 2, index * 10)

        -- Color rides the same focus weight as the swell, so the accent
        -- travels with the magnifier and cools back to the resting color.
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(kRestFill, kFocusFill, focus)
    end

    -- Pass 2: reflow around the line's center character. Using a stable
    -- center anchor prevents discrete jumps when focus shifts across indices.
    local anchorIndex = math.ceil(ctx.char_count / 2)
    ctx.chars[anchorIndex].offset_x = 0.5
    mt.layout.reflow(ctx, kRetypesetTracking, {
        mode = "horizontal",
        anchor = anchorIndex,
    })
end
description:
Focus-sweep telop. The line never moves; instead a magnifying focus
runs through it twice, swelling each character it crosses and pushing
the neighbors aside -- revealing on the first pass, wiping on the second.
title: Focus Flow
author: Mug

name: 36_hiccup.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 8
-- @title Hiccup
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Hiccup telop. The line stays perfectly still and readable, but every
couple of seconds one random character puffs up and elastically settles
back, squeezing its neighbors aside just for that moment.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kFadeStagger = 0.3 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters
local kFirstHiccupDelay = 1.2 -- seconds before the first hiccup
local kHiccupInterval = 1.7 -- average seconds between hiccups
local kHiccupJitter = 0.8 -- random extra delay per hiccup
local kSwellAmount = 0.65 -- extra scale at the peak of a hiccup
local kSwellRise = 0.09 -- seconds the puff takes to reach its peak
local kSettleDuration = 0.7 -- seconds the elastic settle takes
local kMaxEvents = 64 -- scheduling scan limit
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

    -- Find the most recent hiccup at or before now. Events are spaced by
    -- at least the base interval, so at most one is ever in flight.
    local latestOrdinal = 0
    local latestTime = 0.0
    local eventTime = kFirstHiccupDelay
    for ordinal = 1, kMaxEvents do
        eventTime = eventTime + mt.random_range(seed, ordinal, 0.0, kHiccupJitter)
        if eventTime > ctx.time then
            break
        end
        latestOrdinal = ordinal
        latestTime = eventTime
        eventTime = eventTime + kHiccupInterval
    end

    -- Hiccups only fire while the telop is fully on screen.
    local calm = mt.saturate(introAmount * 2.0 - 1.0) * (1.0 - outroAmount)
    local swell = 0.0
    local hiccupIndex = 1
    if latestOrdinal > 0 then
        local sinceHiccup = ctx.time - latestTime
        local rise = mt.saturate(sinceHiccup / kSwellRise)
        local settle = mt.ease.out_elastic(mt.saturate(sinceHiccup / kSettleDuration))
        swell = kSwellAmount * rise * (1.0 - settle) * calm
        hiccupIndex = math.floor(mt.random_range(
            seed, latestOrdinal + kMaxEvents, 1.0, ctx.char_count + 0.999))
        hiccupIndex = mt.clamp(hiccupIndex, 1, ctx.char_count)
    end

    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local appear = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local vanish = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        character.opacity = appear * (1.0 - vanish)
    end

    -- Touch the layout only while a hiccup is visibly in flight, so the
    -- resting telop keeps the untouched host layout.
    if swell > 0.001 then
        ctx.chars[hiccupIndex].scale = 1.0 + swell
        ctx.chars[hiccupIndex].offset_x = 0.5
        mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
            anchor = hiccupIndex,
        })
    end
end
description:
Hiccup telop. The line stays perfectly still and readable, but every
couple of seconds one random character puffs up and elastically settles
back, squeezing its neighbors aside just for that moment.
title: Hiccup
author: Mug

name: 37_pass_through.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 8
-- @title Pass Through
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Something-runs-under-it telop. The line rests still, but every few
seconds an invisible little something scurries along it: a local gap
opens at its position, travels down the line and snaps shut behind it.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kFadeStagger = 0.3 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters
local kFirstPassDelay = 1.3 -- seconds before the first run
local kPassInterval = 2.2 -- average seconds between runs
local kPassJitter = 0.9 -- random extra delay per run
local kPassDuration = 0.55 -- seconds one run takes end to end
local kGapWidth = 0.016 -- canvas fraction each side is pushed at the peak
local kGapSpread = 1.3 -- characters over which the push decays
local kTiltDegrees = 7.0 -- characters lean away from the runner
local kMaxEvents = 64 -- scheduling scan limit
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local characterCount = ctx.char_count

    -- Most recent run at or before now (never more than one in flight).
    local latestOrdinal = 0
    local latestTime = 0.0
    local eventTime = kFirstPassDelay
    for ordinal = 1, kMaxEvents do
        eventTime = eventTime + mt.random_range(seed, ordinal, 0.0, kPassJitter)
        if eventTime > ctx.time then
            break
        end
        latestOrdinal = ordinal
        latestTime = eventTime
        eventTime = eventTime + kPassInterval
    end

    local calm = mt.saturate(introAmount * 2.0 - 1.0) * (1.0 - outroAmount)
    local gapStrength = 0.0
    local runnerPosition = 0.0
    if latestOrdinal > 0 then
        local runProgress = (ctx.time - latestTime) / kPassDuration
        if runProgress <= 1.0 then
            -- The gap eases open on entry and shut on exit of the run.
            gapStrength = math.sin(mt.saturate(runProgress) * math.pi) * calm
            -- Runner travels past both ends; direction alternates.
            local span = characterCount + 2.0 * kGapSpread
            local along = -kGapSpread + runProgress * span
            if latestOrdinal % 2 == 0 then
                along = characterCount + kGapSpread - runProgress * span
            end
            runnerPosition = along
        end
    end

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local appear = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local vanish = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        character.opacity = appear * (1.0 - vanish)

        if gapStrength > 0.001 then
            local distance = index - runnerPosition
            local falloff = mt.falloff(distance, kGapSpread)
            local side = 1.0
            if distance < 0.0 then
                side = -1.0
            end
            character.offset_x = 0.5 + side * falloff * kGapWidth * gapStrength
            character.rotation = side * falloff * kTiltDegrees * gapStrength
        end
    end
end
description:
Something-runs-under-it telop. The line rests still, but every few
seconds an invisible little something scurries along it: a local gap
opens at its position, travels down the line and snaps shut behind it.
title: Pass Through
author: Mug

name: 38_bellows_wave.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 8
-- @title Bellows Wave
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Bellows-wave telop. Every few seconds a compression wave is born at a
random character and races toward both ends, squeezing then stretching
each character it crosses so the line pleats like an accordion.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kFadeStagger = 0.3 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters
local kFirstWaveDelay = 1.2 -- seconds before the first wave
local kWaveInterval = 2.4 -- average seconds between waves
local kWaveJitter = 1.0 -- random extra delay per wave
local kWaveSpeed = 14.0 -- characters per second the front travels
local kPulseWidth = 1.1 -- characters wide the squeeze/stretch pulse is
local kPulseAmount = 0.3 -- stretch_x swing at the peak
local kTintStrength = 0.8 -- how strongly the tint rides the front
local kMaxEvents = 64 -- scheduling scan limit
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kBaseFill = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kWaveFill = { r = 0.45, g = 0.75, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local characterCount = ctx.char_count

    -- Most recent wave at or before now.
    local latestOrdinal = 0
    local latestTime = 0.0
    local eventTime = kFirstWaveDelay
    for ordinal = 1, kMaxEvents do
        eventTime = eventTime + mt.random_range(seed, ordinal, 0.0, kWaveJitter)
        if eventTime > ctx.time then
            break
        end
        latestOrdinal = ordinal
        latestTime = eventTime
        eventTime = eventTime + kWaveInterval
    end

    local calm = mt.saturate(introAmount * 2.0 - 1.0) * (1.0 - outroAmount)
    local waveAlive = false
    local originIndex = 1
    local frontDistance = 0.0
    if latestOrdinal > 0 then
        originIndex = math.floor(mt.random_range(
            seed, latestOrdinal + kMaxEvents, 1.0, characterCount + 0.999))
        originIndex = mt.clamp(originIndex, 1, characterCount)
        frontDistance = (ctx.time - latestTime) * kWaveSpeed
        -- The wave dies once the front has cleared the farther end.
        local farthestReach = math.max(originIndex - 1, characterCount - originIndex)
            + kPulseWidth * 3.0
        waveAlive = frontDistance <= farthestReach and calm > 0.001
    end

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local appear = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local vanish = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        character.opacity = appear * (1.0 - vanish)

        if waveAlive then
            -- Signed distance from the wavefront: negative before the
            -- front arrives, positive after it has passed. The pulse
            -- squeezes just ahead of the front and stretches just
            -- behind it (derivative-of-gaussian profile).
            local behindFront = frontDistance - math.abs(index - originIndex)
            local normalized = behindFront / kPulseWidth
            local pulse = -normalized * math.exp(-normalized * normalized)

            character.stretch_x = 1.0 + pulse * kPulseAmount * 2.0 * calm
            local tint = math.exp(-normalized * normalized) * kTintStrength * calm
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(kBaseFill, kWaveFill, tint)
        end
    end

    -- Accordion spacing: reflow around the wave's origin so the width
    -- pulse folds real pleats instead of overlapping glyphs.
    if waveAlive then
        ctx.chars[originIndex].offset_x = 0.5
        mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
            anchor = originIndex,
        })
    end
end
description:
Bellows-wave telop. Every few seconds a compression wave is born at a
random character and races toward both ends, squeezing then stretching
each character it crosses so the line pleats like an accordion.
title: Bellows Wave
author: Mug

name: 39_calm_breath.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 8
-- @title Calm Breath
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.3
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Calm breathing telop, built for text that stays on screen a long time.
The whole line visibly inhales, holds, exhales and rests as its size,
width, tracking and height move together in one calm gesture.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kBreathPeriod = 5.2 -- seconds per full breath
local kInhaleEnd = 0.32 -- normalized end of the inhale
local kHoldEnd = 0.42 -- normalized end of the full-lung hold
local kExhaleEnd = 0.88 -- normalized end of the exhale
local kBreathScale = 0.055 -- scale gain at full inhale
local kBreathStretch = 0.035 -- horizontal expansion at full inhale
local kBreathTracking = 0.018 -- em added at full inhale
local kBreathLift = 0.004 -- canvas-height lift at full inhale
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

local function getBreathAmount(time)
    -- Four deliberately unequal phases make the motion read as breathing
    -- instead of an endlessly oscillating scale control.
    local phase = (time % kBreathPeriod) / kBreathPeriod
    local amount = 0.0
    if phase < kInhaleEnd then
        amount = mt.ease.in_out_sine(phase / kInhaleEnd)
    elseif phase < kHoldEnd then
        amount = 1.0
    elseif phase < kExhaleEnd then
        amount = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_out_sine(
            (phase - kHoldEnd) / (kExhaleEnd - kHoldEnd))
    end
    return amount
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local fadeIn = mt.ease.out_quad(introAmount)
    local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount)
    local breathAmount = getBreathAmount(ctx.time)

    ctx.global.scale = ctx.global.scale * (1.0 + breathAmount * kBreathScale)
    ctx.global.stretch_x = ctx.global.stretch_x * (1.0 + breathAmount * kBreathStretch)
    ctx.global.tracking = ctx.global.tracking + breathAmount * kBreathTracking
    ctx.global.position_y = ctx.global.position_y + breathAmount * kBreathLift
    ctx.global.opacity = ctx.global.opacity * fadeIn * (1.0 - fadeOut)
end
description:
Calm breathing telop, built for text that stays on screen a long time.
The whole line visibly inhales, holds, exhales and rests as its size,
width, tracking and height move together in one calm gesture.
title: Calm Breath
author: Mug

name: 40_water_float.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 8
-- @title Water Float
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.2
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Water-float telop for long-running text. A broad swell travels beneath
the line, lifting, tilting and stretching each character while smaller
currents keep the surface from repeating mechanically.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kSwellPeriod = 4.2 -- seconds for a swell to cross the line
local kSwellCycles = 1.15 -- wave cycles distributed across the characters
local kVerticalAmount = 0.018 -- canvas-height lift from the main swell
local kHorizontalAmount = 0.006 -- canvas-width drift from small currents
local kSwayDegrees = 5.5 -- rotation from the swell slope
local kFloatScale = 0.07 -- scale gain at a wave crest
local kStretchAmount = 0.045 -- vertical stretch riding the water
local kCurrentSpeed = 0.35 -- time scale of the secondary current
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local fadeIn = mt.ease.out_quad(introAmount)
    local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount)
    local fade = fadeIn * (1.0 - fadeOut)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        -- The main wave is coherent across the line; smooth noise adds a
        -- smaller current without destroying the readable traveling front.
        local phase = -info.progress * math.pi * 2.0 * kSwellCycles
        local swell = mt.wave(ctx.time, 1.0 / kSwellPeriod, phase)
        local slope = mt.wave(ctx.time, 1.0 / kSwellPeriod, phase + math.pi * 0.5)
        local current = mt.noise1(ctx.time * kCurrentSpeed + index * 2.7, 41)
        local crest = math.max(swell, 0.0)

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + current * kHorizontalAmount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + swell * kVerticalAmount
        character.rotation = character.rotation + slope * kSwayDegrees + current
        character.scale = character.scale * (1.0 + crest * kFloatScale)
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (1.0 + swell * kStretchAmount)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * fade
    end
end
description:
Water-float telop for long-running text. A broad swell travels beneath
the line, lifting, tilting and stretching each character while smaller
currents keep the surface from repeating mechanically.
title: Water Float
author: Mug

name: 41_quiet_sheen.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 12
-- @title Quiet Sheen
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.2
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Quiet sheen telop for long-running text. A broad reflection and a sharp
specular core sweep across individual glyph parts, briefly lifting
their brightness and surface without replacing the inspector hue.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kSheenPeriod = 6.0 -- seconds between the starts of two passes
local kSheenDelay = 0.8 -- calm lead before each pass
local kSheenTravelTime = 2.6 -- seconds one pass takes to cross the canvas
local kHaloHalfWidth = 0.16 -- canvas fraction of the broad reflection
local kCoreHalfWidth = 0.045 -- canvas fraction of the specular core
local kTrailingDistance = 0.09 -- separation of the secondary glint
local kRestBrightness = 0.72 -- exposure multiplier away from the reflection
local kPeakBrightness = 1.35 -- exposure multiplier at full intensity
local kSurfaceLift = 0.035 -- local scale gain at the specular core
local kFallbackClipLength = 12.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

local function applyExposurePreservingHue(color, intensity)
    -- Equal RGB gain creates contrast even from a white inspector fill while
    -- preserving hue ratios instead of mixing in a separate highlight color.
    local brightestChannel = math.max(color.r, color.g, color.b)
    local gain = mt.lerp(kRestBrightness, kPeakBrightness, intensity)
    if brightestChannel > 0.0 and gain > 1.0 then
        gain = math.min(gain, 1.0 / brightestChannel)
    end
    return {
        r = color.r * gain,
        g = color.g * gain,
        b = color.b * gain,
        a = color.a,
    }
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local fadeIn = mt.ease.out_quad(introAmount)
    local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount)
    ctx.global.opacity = ctx.global.opacity * fadeIn * (1.0 - fadeOut)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    -- The front exists only during the pass; the rest of each period leaves
    -- every inspector-defined surface completely untouched.
    local cycleTime = ctx.time % kSheenPeriod
    local travel = mt.saturate((cycleTime - kSheenDelay) / kSheenTravelTime)
    local passActive = cycleTime >= kSheenDelay
        and cycleTime <= kSheenDelay + kSheenTravelTime
    local front = -2.0
    if passActive then
        front = -kHaloHalfWidth * 2.0
            + mt.ease.in_out_sine(travel) * (1.0 + 4.0 * kHaloHalfWidth)
    end

    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local distance = part.geometry.canvas_center_x - front
        local halo = mt.falloff(distance, kHaloHalfWidth)
        local core = mt.falloff(distance, kCoreHalfWidth)
        local trailingGlint = mt.falloff(
            distance - kTrailingDistance,
            kCoreHalfWidth * 0.8)
        local intensity = mt.saturate(halo * 0.3 + core * 0.85 + trailingGlint * 0.45)
        local baseColor, fillMode = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, part)

        if fillMode ~= "transparent" then
            part.fill.use = true
            part.fill.color = applyExposurePreservingHue(baseColor, intensity)
            part.scale = part.scale * (1.0 + core * kSurfaceLift)
        end
    end
end
description:
Quiet sheen telop for long-running text. A broad reflection and a sharp
specular core sweep across individual glyph parts, briefly lifting
their brightness and surface without replacing the inspector hue.
title: Quiet Sheen
author: Mug

name: 42_slow_sun.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 12
-- @title Slow Sun
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.2
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Sundial telop for long-running on-screen text, such as a streamer's
always-on caption. A long morning shadow contracts toward noon, then
stretches toward evening while crossing beneath the stationary line.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kArcDegrees = 150.0 -- total shadow sweep around the inspector angle
local kHorizonDistance = 3.2 -- added distance near sunrise and sunset
local kNoonDistance = 0.55 -- added distance at the top of the arc
local kNoonOpacity = 0.45 -- shadow alpha multiplier at noon
local kFallbackClipLength = 12.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local fadeIn = mt.ease.out_quad(introAmount)
    local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount)
    local sunProgress = mt.ease.in_out_sine(
        mt.timeline.progress(ctx, kFallbackClipLength))
    local sunHeight = math.sin(sunProgress * math.pi)
    local horizonAmount = 1.0 - sunHeight

    local inspectorAngle = ctx.global.shadow.angle
    local inspectorDistance = ctx.global.shadow.distance
    local inspectorColor = ctx.global.shadow.color

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = inspectorAngle
        + mt.lerp(-kArcDegrees * 0.5, kArcDegrees * 0.5, sunProgress)
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = inspectorDistance
        + mt.lerp(kNoonDistance, kHorizonDistance, horizonAmount)
    ctx.global.shadow.color = mt.color.with_alpha(
        inspectorColor,
        inspectorColor.a * mt.lerp(kNoonOpacity, 1.0, horizonAmount))
    ctx.global.opacity = ctx.global.opacity * fadeIn * (1.0 - fadeOut)
end
description:
Sundial telop for long-running on-screen text, such as a streamer's
always-on caption. A long morning shadow contracts toward noon, then
stretches toward evening while crossing beneath the stationary line.
title: Slow Sun
author: Mug

name: 43_word_pulse.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6
-- @recommend text "HERE|PULSE!|>"
-- @title Word Pulse
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
An emphasized-word heartbeat. One word of the line beats as a single
coherent phrase, expanding and contracting while the text to its right
is pushed aside and the rest of the line stays put.
]]

local kWordStart = 6
local kWordEnd = 11
local kLeftDividerIndex = 5
local kRightDividerIndex = 12
local kIntroDuration = 0.45
local kOutroDuration = 0.55
local kFirstHeartbeatTime = 0.9
local kHeartbeatPeriod = 1.55
local kHeartbeatScale = 0.42
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kBaseFill = { r = 0.92, g = 0.95, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kDividerFill = { r = 0.25, g = 0.7, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kWordRestFill = { r = 1.0, g = 0.72, b = 0.18, a = 1.0 }
local kWordBeatFill = { r = 1.0, g = 0.18, b = 0.08, a = 1.0 }

local function pulseWindow(time, startTime, peakTime, endTime)
    local amount = 0.0
    if time >= startTime and time <= endTime then
        if time <= peakTime then
            amount = mt.smoothstep(startTime, peakTime, time)
        else
            amount = 1.0 - mt.smoothstep(peakTime, endTime, time)
        end
    end
    return amount
end

local function heartbeatAmount(time)
    local amount = 0.0
    if time >= kFirstHeartbeatTime then
        local beatTime = (time - kFirstHeartbeatTime) % kHeartbeatPeriod
        local primaryBeat = pulseWindow(beatTime, 0.0, 0.09, 0.3)
        local secondaryBeat = 0.52 * pulseWindow(beatTime, 0.31, 0.39, 0.62)
        amount = math.max(primaryBeat, secondaryBeat)
    end
    return amount
end

local function setPivotToHorizontalOrigin(character)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.pivot_x = 0.5 + geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.bounds_center_x
    character.pivot_y = 0.5 + geometry.canvas_origin_y - geometry.bounds_center_y
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count < kRightDividerIndex then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(
            ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_quad(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount))
    local heartbeat = heartbeatAmount(ctx.time) * visibility
    local emphasizedScale = 1.0 + kHeartbeatScale * heartbeat

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        character.opacity = visibility
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = kBaseFill

        if index == kLeftDividerIndex or index >= kRightDividerIndex then
            character.fill.color = kDividerFill
        end

        if index >= kWordStart and index <= kWordEnd then
            character.scale = emphasizedScale
            character.fill.color =
                mt.color.lerp(kWordRestFill, kWordBeatFill, heartbeat)

            -- Scaling around each glyph's horizontal typesetting origin
            -- keeps the word on a stable baseline.
            setPivotToHorizontalOrigin(character)
        end
    end

    -- Only the emphasized word and its suffix participate. The word's first
    -- character is the fixed anchor, so "HERE|" never moves. The right
    -- divider and arrow visibly absorb the word's changing advance.
    local reflowTargets = {}
    for index = kWordStart, ctx.char_count do
        table.insert(reflowTargets, index)
    end

    local anchor = ctx.chars[kWordStart]
    anchor.offset_x = 0.5
    anchor.offset_y = 0.5
    mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
        targets = reflowTargets,
        anchor = kWordStart,
        mode = "horizontal",
    })
end
description:
An emphasized-word heartbeat. One word of the line beats as a single
coherent phrase, expanding and contracting while the text to its right
is pushed aside and the rest of the line stays put.
title: Word Pulse
author: Mug

name: 44_vertical_ink.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 12
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.85 bg #aabbcc
-- @recommend text "花鳥風月\n山紫水明"
-- @title Vertical Ink
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.2
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Vertical ink typography. The text is written stroke by stroke down
its columns, each fresh stroke starting as wet swollen ink and drying
toward sumi gray; the outro drifts the columns up into a mist fade.
]]

local kSecondsPerStroke = 0.13 -- preferred writing rate, anchored to the clip start
local kFinishedHold = 0.4 -- seconds the completed text should at least hold
local kDryDuration = 1.1 -- seconds a stroke takes to dry
local kWetSwell = 0.07 -- extra scale while the ink is wet
local kMistLead = 1.0 -- seconds before clip end the mist fade starts
local kMistDuration = 0.6 -- seconds each character takes to dissolve
local kMistStagger = 0.5 -- dissolve cascade in writing order
local kMistRise = 0.04 -- canvas fraction drifted upward while dissolving
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kWetInk = { r = 0.04, g = 0.04, b = 0.09, a = 1.0 }
local kDriedInk = { r = 0.22, g = 0.22, b = 0.26, a = 1.0 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = true
    ctx.global.v_align = "top"
    ctx.global.h_align = "center"
    ctx.global.line_spacing = 1.15
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local partCount = math.max(ctx.part_count, 1)

    -- Compress the writing rate only when the clip cannot fit every
    -- stroke before the mist fade (plus a short hold on the full text).
    local clipLength = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local writingBudget = math.max(clipLength - kMistLead - kFinishedHold, kFinishedHold)
    local secondsPerStroke = math.min(kSecondsPerStroke, writingBudget / partCount)

    local writtenStrokes = mt.clamp(ctx.time / secondsPerStroke, 0.0, partCount)

    ctx.output.write_on_mode = "part"
    ctx.output.reorder_parts = true
    ctx.output.write_on_start = 0.0
    ctx.output.write_on_end = writtenStrokes / partCount

    -- Drying timing approximates each part's reveal time from its layout
    -- index (same caveat as 08_stroke_order_draw.lua).
    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local sinceDrawn = ctx.time - index * secondsPerStroke
        local dried = mt.ease.out_quad(mt.saturate(sinceDrawn / kDryDuration))

        part.scale = 1.0 + (1.0 - dried) * kWetSwell
        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(kWetInk, kDriedInk, dried)
    end

    local remainingSeconds = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local mistAmount =
        mt.saturate(1.0 - (remainingSeconds - (kMistLead - kMistDuration)) / kMistDuration)
    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local dissolve = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(mistAmount, info.progress, kMistStagger))

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + dissolve * kMistRise
        character.opacity = 1.0 - dissolve
    end
end
description:
Vertical ink typography. The text is written stroke by stroke down
its columns, each fresh stroke starting as wet swollen ink and drying
toward sumi gray; the outro drifts the columns up into a mist fade.
title: Vertical Ink
author: Mug

Vertical sudare telop. A classic Japanese vertical caption whose
characters drop softly into place in reading order, like a bamboo blind
lowered one slat at a time; the outro slips them further down and fades.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.0 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.8 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kStaggerAmount = 0.6 -- reading-order cascade across characters
local kDropDistance = 0.1 -- canvas fraction fallen during the intro
local kExitDistance = 0.08 -- canvas fraction slipped during the outro

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = true
    ctx.global.v_align = "top"
    ctx.global.line_spacing = 1.15
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local settle = mt.ease.out_cubic(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kStaggerAmount))
        local slip = mt.ease.in_cubic(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kStaggerAmount))

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + (1.0 - settle) * kDropDistance - slip * kExitDistance
        character.opacity = settle * (1.0 - slip)

end

name: 46_vertical_unroll.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.85 bg #1e1e1e
-- @recommend text "春はあけぼの\nやうやうしろく"
-- @title Vertical Unroll
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Hanging-scroll telop. The vertical text is revealed the way a kakejiku
unrolls: a soft front descends the canvas and every column appears as it
passes; the outro rolls the scroll back up from the bottom.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.1 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.9 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kEdgeSoftness = 0.07 -- canvas fraction over which the front feathers
local kCurlLag = 0.015 -- canvas fraction of the upward curl near the front

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = true
    ctx.global.v_align = "top"
    ctx.global.line_spacing = 1.15
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- Text extents in canvas space (Y-up), padded so the feathered
    -- fronts fully clear both ends.
    local topEdge = -math.huge
    local bottomEdge = math.huge
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        topEdge = math.max(topEdge, geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
        bottomEdge = math.min(bottomEdge, geometry.bounds_center_y - geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
    end
    topEdge = topEdge + kEdgeSoftness
    bottomEdge = bottomEdge - kEdgeSoftness

    -- Unroll front descends from the top; roll-up front climbs from the
    -- bottom (canvas Y grows upward, so descending means decreasing).
    local unrollFront = topEdge
        - mt.ease.in_out_sine(introAmount) * (topEdge - bottomEdge)
    local rollUpFront = bottomEdge
        + mt.ease.in_out_sine(outroAmount) * (topEdge - bottomEdge)

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local positionY = character.geometry.bounds_center_y

        local revealed = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kEdgeSoftness, positionY - unrollFront)
        local hidden = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kEdgeSoftness, rollUpFront - positionY)
        if outroAmount <= 0.0 then
            hidden = 0.0
        end

        -- Paper curl: characters right at the front sit a touch high,
        -- easing down as the roller moves past them.
        local frontDistance = positionY - unrollFront
        local curl = mt.falloff(frontDistance, kEdgeSoftness) * kCurlLag

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + curl * (1.0 - mt.saturate(introAmount * 2.0 - 1.0))
        character.opacity = revealed * (1.0 - hidden)
    end
end

passes; the outro rolls the scroll back up from the bottom.

name: 47_vertical_sway.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 8
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.85 bg #1e1e1e
-- @recommend text "たなばたさま\nささのはさらさら"
-- @title Vertical Sway
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Tanzaku telop. Each vertical column hangs like a paper strip tied at
its top, swinging gently in a slow breeze that grows with hanging depth;
columns swing on their own phases so they never move in lockstep.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.8 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.8 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kSwaySpeed = 0.22 -- swings per second
local kSwayDegrees = 3.0 -- character tilt at the deepest point
local kSwayDrift = 0.055 -- horizontal drift per unit of hanging depth
local kColumnPhase = 1.4 -- radians between neighboring columns
local kDepthLag = 2.6 -- radians of wave lag per unit of hanging depth
local kBreezeSpeed = 0.11 -- slow noise that varies the breeze strength
local kFadeStagger = 0.3 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = true
    ctx.global.v_align = "top"
    ctx.global.line_spacing = 1.2
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- The tie point: the top edge of the laid-out text (canvas Y-up).
    local topEdge = -math.huge
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        topEdge = math.max(topEdge, geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
    end

    -- The breeze swells and dies on smooth noise, shared by all strips.
    local breeze = 0.6 + 0.4 * mt.noise1(ctx.time * kBreezeSpeed, 61)

    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local depth = math.max(topEdge - character.geometry.bounds_center_y, 0.0)
        local phase = character.line_index * kColumnPhase - depth * kDepthLag
        local swing = mt.wave(ctx.time, kSwaySpeed, phase) * breeze

        character.offset_x = 0.5 + swing * depth * kSwayDrift
        character.rotation = swing * kSwayDegrees * mt.saturate(depth * 3.0)

        local appear = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local vanish = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        character.opacity = appear * (1.0 - vanish)
    end
end
title: Vertical Sway
author: Mug

name: 48_vertical_smoke.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.85 bg #1e1e1e
-- @recommend text "ゆらゆらと\nたちのぼる"
-- @title Vertical Smoke
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Incense-smoke telop. Vertical text materializes the way smoke climbs:
each character rises into its spot swaying on noise that dies away, and
at the outro drifts upward and thins out until the column disperses.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.2 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 1.1 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kStaggerAmount = 0.55 -- reading-order cascade across characters
local kRiseDistance = 0.12 -- canvas fraction climbed during the intro
local kDisperseDistance = 0.16 -- canvas fraction drifted up during the outro
local kSwayAmount = 0.018 -- canvas fraction of the smoke sway while loose
local kIdleSwayAmount = 0.002 -- residual sway while settled
local kSwaySpeed = 0.6 -- sway noise time scale
local kDisperseStretch = 0.25 -- vertical thinning while dispersing

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = true
    ctx.global.v_align = "top"
    ctx.global.line_spacing = 1.2
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local settle = mt.ease.out_cubic(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kStaggerAmount))
        local disperse = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kStaggerAmount))

        -- Loose = how smoke-like the character currently is: fully loose
        -- while rising and again while dispersing, near zero at rest.
        local loose = math.max(1.0 - settle, disperse)
        local swayStrength = kIdleSwayAmount + (kSwayAmount - kIdleSwayAmount) * loose
        local sway = mt.noise1(ctx.time * kSwaySpeed + index * 2.7, 71) * swayStrength

        character.offset_x = 0.5 + sway
        character.offset_y = 0.5 - (1.0 - settle) * kRiseDistance + disperse * kDisperseDistance
        character.stretch_y = 1.0 + disperse * kDisperseStretch
        character.opacity = settle * (1.0 - disperse)
    end
end

name: 49_antigravity_singularity.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5.0
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend bg #040509
-- @title Antigravity Singularity
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Quantum zero-G field. Parts spring out of a central singularity, then
hang in deep-space platinum with cyan quantum flicker and a weightless
multi-octave drift; the outro deconstructs the grid into 3D space.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.2
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kStaggerInterval = 0.03
local kSpringFrequency = 2.2
local kSpringDamping = 3.5
local kZeroGHorizontalAmount = 0.005
local kZeroGVerticalAmount = 0.009
local kMaxOpacity = 1.0

local kColorDeepSpace = { r = 0.88, g = 0.90, b = 0.94, a = 1.0 }
local kColorCyanTint = { r = 0.25, g = 0.85, b = 0.95, a = 1.0 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Gentle anti-gravitational spatial posture rotation
    ctx.global.rotation = ctx.global.rotation + mt.wave(time, 0.12, 0.0) * 1.5
    ctx.global.yaw = ctx.global.yaw + mt.wave(time, 0.15, 0.5) * 4.0
    ctx.global.pitch = ctx.global.pitch + mt.wave(time, 0.18, 1.0) * 2.5

    -- Global opacity blending
    ctx.global.opacity = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - outroProgress)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local remainingTime = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)
    local instanceSeed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local totalParts = ctx.part_count

    -- Keep every glyph assembled during the idle drift. Independent part
    -- motion made neighboring characters collide and broke their silhouettes.
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local wiggleX = mt.wiggle(
            time,
            0.35,
            kZeroGHorizontalAmount,
            2,
            instanceSeed + index)
        local wiggleY = mt.wiggle(
            time,
            0.28,
            kZeroGVerticalAmount,
            2,
            instanceSeed + index * 2)
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + wiggleX
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + wiggleY
    end

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry

        -- 1. Intro: Physical spring fluid transition from singularity
        local staggerTime = (index - 1) * kStaggerInterval
        local introTime = time - staggerTime
        local introProgressPart = mt.clamp(introTime / 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)
        local springSettle = mt.spring(introTime, kSpringFrequency, kSpringDamping)

        local dx = 0.5 - geometry.canvas_center_x
        local dy = 0.5 - geometry.canvas_center_y
        local introOffsetX = 0.5 + dx * springSettle
        local introOffsetY = 0.5 + dy * springSettle
        local introZ = springSettle * 1.5
        local introScale = mt.lerp(0.1, 1.0, mt.ease.out_expo(introProgressPart))

        -- 2. Outro: Grid Deconstruction (seamless normalized window)
        local staggerRatio = 0.025
        local partOutroWindowStart = (index - 1) * staggerRatio
        local partOutroWindowSpan = math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (totalParts - 1) * staggerRatio)
        local partOutroRaw = mt.clamp((outroProgress - partOutroWindowStart) / partOutroWindowSpan, 0.0, 1.0)
        local partOutroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(partOutroRaw)

        local gridDirection = (index % 2 == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local outroOffsetX = partOutroEased * 0.1 * gridDirection
        local outroZ = partOutroEased * -0.8
        local outroYaw = partOutroEased * 90.0 * gridDirection

        -- 3. Idle: part-level depth drift and quantum spectrum
        local driftZ = mt.wave(time, 0.3, index * 0.2) * 0.02

        local distFromCenter = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        local rippleHue = mt.wrap(time * 0.2 + distFromCenter * 1.5, 0.0, 1.0)
        local oklchColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78, 0.18, rippleHue, 1.0)
        local quantumPulse = (mt.wave(time * 1.5, 0.6, distFromCenter * 3.0) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.3
        local finalColor = mt.color.lerp(kColorDeepSpace, oklchColor, quantumPulse)

        -- Composite transform
        part.offset_x = introOffsetX + outroOffsetX
        part.offset_y = introOffsetY
        part.z = introZ + outroZ + driftZ
        part.yaw = outroYaw
        part.scale = introScale * (1.0 - partOutroEased * 0.4)
        part.opacity = mt.clamp(introProgressPart * (1.0 - partOutroEased), 0.0, kMaxOpacity)

        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = finalColor
    end
end
description:
Quantum zero-G field. Parts spring out of a central singularity, then
hang in deep-space platinum with cyan quantum flicker and a weightless
multi-octave drift; the outro deconstructs the grid into 3D space.
title: Antigravity Singularity

name: 50_architectural_kinetic_typography.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 4.0
-- @title Architectural Kinetic Typography
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Architectural kinetic typography. A minimalist monochrome title: wide
tracking collapses into precise grid alignment with a sharp bounding
box, breathes under a subtle camera dolly, then slides cleanly away.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.0
local kOutroDuration = 0.8
local kWideTrackingStart = 0.45
local kNormalTracking = 0.0
local kMaxOpacity = 1.0
local kBoxMargin = 120.0
local kBoxWidth = 12.0
local kBoxCornerRadius = 4.0
local kCameraZoomMin = 1.0
local kCameraZoomMax = 1.05
local kBreathFrequency = 0.3

local kColorTextNormal = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.95, a = 1.0 }
local kColorBoxStroke = { r = 0.85, g = 0.86, b = 0.88, a = 0.85 }
local kColorBoxFill = { r = 0.12, g = 0.13, b = 0.16, a = 0.4 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Dynamic wide tracking collapse to normal grid pitch
    local introTrackingProgress = mt.ease.out_expo(introProgress)
    local introTracking = mt.lerp(kWideTrackingStart, kNormalTracking, introTrackingProgress)
    local outroTracking = outroProgress * 0.15
    local breathTracking = mt.wave(time, kBreathFrequency, 0.0) * 0.015
    ctx.global.tracking = introTracking + outroTracking + breathTracking

    -- Subtle camera dolly for cinematic depth
    local cameraZoom = mt.lerp(kCameraZoomMin, kCameraZoomMax, mt.ease.in_out_sine(introProgress))
    ctx.camera.zoom = cameraZoom + mt.wave(time, 0.25, 0.0) * 0.01

    -- Smooth global opacity control
    local introOpacity = mt.clamp(introProgress * 2.0, 0.0, kMaxOpacity)
    local outroOpacity = 1.0 - outroProgress
    ctx.global.opacity = introOpacity * outroOpacity
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local remainingTime = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Architectural Bounding Box configuration
    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.width = kBoxWidth
    ctx.bounding_box.color = kColorBoxStroke
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_color = kColorBoxFill
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_opacity = 0.4 * (1.0 - outroProgress)
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_x = kBoxMargin * (0.8 + 0.2 * mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress))
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_y = kBoxMargin * 0.6
    ctx.bounding_box.corner_radius = kBoxCornerRadius
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_top = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_bottom = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_left = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_right = true

    -- Character-level linear slide and smooth staggered outro
    local totalChars = ctx.char_count
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local staggerRatio = 0.04

        -- Intro character vertical slide (smooth drop-in)
        local charIntroRaw = mt.clamp((time - (index - 1) * 0.03) / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charIntroEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(charIntroRaw)
        local introOffsetY = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -0.06

        -- Outro character horizontal slide (seamless staggered motion anchored to outroProgress)
        -- Normalizing window so all characters finish smoothly before clip end without sudden stop
        local charOutroWindowStart = (index - 1) * staggerRatio
        local charOutroWindowSpan = math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (totalChars - 1) * staggerRatio)
        local charOutroRaw = mt.clamp((outroProgress - charOutroWindowStart) / charOutroWindowSpan, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charOutroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(charOutroRaw)
        local outroOffsetX = charOutroEased * 0.12

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + introOffsetY
        character.offset_x = 0.5 + outroOffsetX
        character.opacity = charIntroEased * (1.0 - charOutroEased)

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = kColorTextNormal
    end
end
description:
Architectural kinetic typography. A minimalist monochrome title: wide
tracking collapses into precise grid alignment with a sharp bounding
box, breathes under a subtle camera dolly, then slides cleanly away.
title: Architectural Kinetic Typography
author: Mug

name: 51_ripple_echo.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5.5
-- @title Ripple Echo
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Concentric ripple echo. A ring-shaped shockwave expands from the text's
center, lifting and flashing each character as the front reaches it, so
the wave travels through multi-line layouts as a circle. The outro
reverses the ring and glyphs sink back to stillness from the outside in.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.1 -- seconds for the first wake front to finish
local kOutroDuration = 0.85 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.5 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kWakeRadius = 0.55 -- canvas units the intro front travels past center
local kWaveSpeed = 0.42 -- canvas units per second of the idle harmonic
local kWaveWidth = 0.07 -- half-width of the ring's gaussian envelope
local kLiftHeight = 0.045 -- canvas-height fraction at peak crest
local kScalePop = 0.22 -- extra scale at the crest
local kIdleAmplitude = 0.55 -- relative strength of the continuous harmonic
local kBaseHue = 0.55 -- cyan resting hue
local kFlashHue = 0.08 -- warm flash hue at the crest

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- Intro front starts collapsed at the center and expands outward.
    local introFront = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * kWakeRadius
    -- Idle harmonic keeps a slow ring pinging forever after the wake.
    local idleFront = mt.cycle(ctx.time, kWakeRadius / kWaveSpeed) * kWakeRadius
    -- Outro front collapses from the outside back to the center.
    local outroFront = (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount)) * kWakeRadius

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local radius = mt.layout.radial_distance(
            ctx,
            geometry.bounds_center_x,
            geometry.bounds_center_y
        )

        local introCrest = mt.falloff(radius - introFront, kWaveWidth)
        local idleCrest =
            mt.falloff(radius - idleFront, kWaveWidth) * kIdleAmplitude * introAmount
        local outroCrest = mt.falloff(radius - outroFront, kWaveWidth) * outroAmount

        -- Characters "wake" once the intro front has passed them, and
        -- fall back asleep as the outro front reclaims them from outside.
        local woken = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kWaveWidth * 1.5, introFront - radius)
        local asleep = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kWaveWidth * 1.5, radius - outroFront)
        local presence = woken * (1.0 - asleep * outroAmount)

        local crest = introCrest + idleCrest + outroCrest
        local lift = crest * kLiftHeight
        -- Outro also gently sinks the whole line so the exit is not only a
        -- ring fade but a physical collapse.
        local sink = outroAmount * 0.03

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + lift - sink
        character.scale = 1.0 + crest * kScalePop
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(presence * 1.15) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount) * 0.35)

        local flash = mt.saturate(introCrest + idleCrest * 0.6)
        local restingColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kBaseHue, 0.35, 0.92, 1.0)
        local flashColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kFlashHue, 0.75, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(restingColor, flashColor, flash)
    end
end
description:
Concentric ripple echo. A ring-shaped shockwave expands from the text's
center, lifting and flashing each character as the front reaches it, so
the wave travels through multi-line layouts as a circle. The outro
reverses the ring and glyphs sink back to stillness from the outside in.
title: Ripple Echo
author: Mug

name: 52_curious_lean.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @required 3d
-- @title Curious Lean
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Curious lean-in (3D). Glyphs peer in from the wings with a skeptical
side-tilt, keep thinking through micro head-tilts and a slow yaw drift
without ever settling, then spin on their heel and shrug off screen.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.15
local kOutroDuration = 0.95
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.5
local kWingDistance = 0.28 -- canvas fraction slid in from the side
local kPeekDrop = 0.04 -- slight drop while peeking in
local kIntroTiltDegrees = 18.0
local kSteadyTiltDegrees = 5.5
local kSteadyTiltFrequency = 0.55 -- Hz, thinking nod cadence
local kSteadyYawDegrees = 7.0
local kSteadyPulse = 0.06 -- scale breath while thinking
local kOutroSpinDegrees = 55.0
local kOutroKick = 0.34 -- canvas fraction of the exit shove
local kAmberHue = 0.08
local kSteelHue = 0.58

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local steadyAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    -- Room re-read: slow global yaw only while thinking.
    ctx.global.yaw = mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.11, 0.0) * kSteadyYawDegrees * steadyAmount
    ctx.global.pitch = mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.09, 1.2) * 2.0 * steadyAmount
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        -- Per-character block weights (each finishes before clip end).
        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_back(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_back(outroRaw)
        local introClamped = mt.saturate(introEased)
        local steadyWeight = introClamped * (1.0 - outroEased)

        -- Wing side alternates so the lean-in reads as a crowd, not a march.
        local wingSign = ((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local personality = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.75, 1.25)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: side-eye peek from the wings
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introRemain = 1.0 - introClamped
        local introOffsetX = wingSign * kWingDistance * introRemain * personality
        local introOffsetY = -kPeekDrop * introRemain
        local introRotation = -wingSign * kIntroTiltDegrees * introRemain
        local introOpacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 2.2)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: thinking tilts + sly amber pulse (never still)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local thinkPhase = ctx.time * kSteadyTiltFrequency * math.pi * 2.0
            + index * 0.85
            + personality
        local thinkTilt = math.sin(thinkPhase) * kSteadyTiltDegrees * steadyWeight * personality
        local thinkNod = math.sin(thinkPhase * 0.5 + 0.4) * 0.008 * steadyWeight
        local thinkPulse = 1.0
            + math.sin(thinkPhase * 1.3) * kSteadyPulse * steadyWeight
        local amberMix = (math.sin(thinkPhase * 0.7) * 0.5 + 0.5) * steadyWeight * 0.55

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: heel-spin shrug and opposite-wing exit
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroOffsetX = -wingSign * kOutroKick * outroEased * personality
        local outroOffsetY = kPeekDrop * 0.6 * outroEased
        local outroRotation = wingSign * kOutroSpinDegrees * outroEased
        local wink = 1.0 + math.sin(outroEased * math.pi) * 0.18
        local outroFade = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        character.offset_x = 0.5 + introOffsetX + outroOffsetX
        character.offset_y = 0.5 + introOffsetY + thinkNod + outroOffsetY
        character.rotation = introRotation + thinkTilt + outroRotation
        character.scale = thinkPulse * wink
        character.opacity = introOpacity * outroFade

        local steel = mt.color.from_hsv(kSteelHue, 0.18, 0.92, 1.0)
        local amber = mt.color.from_hsv(kAmberHue, 0.72, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(steel, amber, amberMix)
    end
end
description:
Curious lean-in (3D). Glyphs peer in from the wings with a skeptical
side-tilt, keep thinking through micro head-tilts and a slow yaw drift
without ever settling, then spin on their heel and shrug off screen.
title: Curious Lean

name: 53_neural_spark.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Neural Spark
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Neural spark: chaos to answer to punchline. Glyphs scatter as noisy
half-formed thoughts and snap onto the baseline in one decisive click,
idle with a hue current and voltage-breathing strokes, then detonate
into high-energy fragments instead of fading politely.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.25
local kOutroDuration = 1.0
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.48
local kChaosMin = 0.14
local kChaosMax = 0.38
local kChaosSpin = 140.0
local kSpringFrequency = 3.6
local kSpringDamping = 3.4
local kTokenHop = 0.012 -- canvas fraction of steady token ticks
local kTokenFrequency = 1.4 -- Hz base for token hops
local kStrokeBase = 0.01
local kStrokePulse = 0.012
local kPunchDistance = 0.42
local kPunchSpin = 200.0
local kPunchScale = 0.45

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local steadyAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    -- Thought-current tracking: slightly tight while answering, looser
    -- in chaos / punchline so fragments can breathe.
    ctx.global.tracking = mt.lerp(0.06, 0.0, steadyAmount)
    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 1.0 + (1.0 - steadyAmount) * 0.8
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 110.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.05, g = 0.15, b = 0.35, a = 0.55 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local time = ctx.time

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        -- Spring commit: scatterWeight 1 = pure chaos, 0 = locked answer.
        local springTime = introRaw * 1.2
        local springSettle = mt.spring(springTime, kSpringFrequency, kSpringDamping)
        local scatterWeight = mt.lerp(1.0, springSettle, mt.saturate(introRaw * 10.0))
        local answerWeight = mt.saturate(1.0 - scatterWeight) * (1.0 - outroEased)
        local steadyWeight = answerWeight

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: noisy half-thoughts → decisive spring commit
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local chaosAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local chaosDistance =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount, kChaosMin, kChaosMax)
        local chaosSpin =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 2, -kChaosSpin, kChaosSpin)
        local introOffsetX = math.cos(chaosAngle) * chaosDistance * scatterWeight
        local introOffsetY = math.sin(chaosAngle) * chaosDistance * scatterWeight
        local introRotation = chaosSpin * scatterWeight
        -- Flicker while uncommitted, solid once the spring locks.
        local chaosFlicker = 0.35
            + 0.65 * mt.random_range(seed + math.floor(time * 18.0), index, 0.0, 1.0)
        local introOpacity = mt.lerp(chaosFlicker, 1.0, mt.saturate(1.0 - scatterWeight))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: voltage current + per-glyph token hops
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local tokenPhase = time * kTokenFrequency * math.pi * 2.0
            + order * math.pi * 1.7
            + mt.random_range(seed, index + 7, 0.0, math.pi)
        -- Soft square-ish hop: mostly down, brief uptick = "token emit".
        local tokenWave = math.max(0.0, math.sin(tokenPhase))
        local tokenHop = tokenWave * tokenWave * kTokenHop * steadyWeight
        local voltage = (mt.wave(time, 0.85, order * 2.4) * 0.5 + 0.5) * steadyWeight
        local currentHue = mt.wrap(0.52 + order * 0.22 + time * 0.08, 0.0, 1.0)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: punchline detonation (new rays, not intro reverse)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local punchAngle =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 3, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local punchSpin =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 4, -kPunchSpin, kPunchSpin)
        local punchOffsetX = math.cos(punchAngle) * kPunchDistance * outroEased
        local punchOffsetY = math.sin(punchAngle) * kPunchDistance * outroEased
        local punchRotation = punchSpin * outroEased
        local punchScale = 1.0 + kPunchScale * outroEased
        local punchFade = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw)

        character.offset_x = 0.5 + introOffsetX + punchOffsetX
        character.offset_y = 0.5 + introOffsetY + tokenHop + punchOffsetY
        character.rotation = introRotation + punchRotation
        character.scale = punchScale
        character.opacity = introOpacity * punchFade

        -- Voltage palette: ice → electric cyan/violet while answering,
        -- blows toward hot white on the punchline.
        local answerColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78 + voltage * 0.1, 0.16 + voltage * 0.08, currentHue, 1.0)
        local chaosColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.55, 0.04, 0.6, 1.0)
        local punchColor = { r = 1.0, g = 0.95, b = 0.88, a = 1.0 }
        local filled = mt.color.lerp(chaosColor, answerColor, answerWeight)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(filled, punchColor, outroEased)

        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width = kStrokeBase + kStrokePulse * voltage
        character.stroke.color = mt.color.from_oklch(0.7, 0.14, currentHue, 0.35 + voltage * 0.5)
        character.stroke.gap = 0.0

        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = {
            r = 0.1,
            g = 0.35,
            b = 0.9,
            a = 0.1 + 0.35 * answerWeight,
        }
    end
end
description:
Neural spark: chaos to answer to punchline. Glyphs scatter as noisy
half-formed thoughts and snap onto the baseline in one decisive click,
idle with a hue current and voltage-breathing strokes, then detonate
into high-energy fragments instead of fading politely.
title: Neural Spark
author: Mug

name: 54_comet_arc.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Comet Arc
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Comet arc path. Each character streaks in along its own Bezier curve
with its rotation following the path tangent, patrols a small
figure-eight while it holds, then flings off-frame along a different arc.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.2
local kOutroDuration = 0.95
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.55
local kSteadyRadius = 0.018 -- figure-eight half-size in offset space
local kSteadyPeriod = 2.8 -- seconds per full idle loop
local kTrailHue = 0.55

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        -- Per-glyph wing and height so the cascade fans out.
        local wingSign = ((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local entryLift = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.12, 0.22)
        local entrySide = wingSign * mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount, 0.18, 0.32)
        local exitSide = -wingSign * mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 2, 0.22, 0.38)
        local exitDrop = mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 3, -0.08, 0.12)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: Bezier comet arrival (path progress 0 → 1)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introP0 = { x = 0.5 + entrySide, y = 0.5 + entryLift }
        local introP1 = { x = 0.5 + entrySide * 0.35, y = 0.5 + entryLift * 0.15 }
        local introP2 = { x = 0.5 - wingSign * 0.04, y = 0.5 - 0.02 }
        local introP3 = { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 }
        local introX, introY, introTangentX, introTangentY =
            mt.path.bezier(introP0, introP1, introP2, introP3, introEased)
        local introRotation = math.deg(math.atan(introTangentY, introTangentX))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: Catmull-Rom figure-eight around the seat
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local loopProgress = mt.cycle(ctx.time + order * 0.35, kSteadyPeriod)
        local idleWaypoints = {
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
            { x = 0.5 + kSteadyRadius, y = 0.5 + kSteadyRadius * 0.55 },
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
            { x = 0.5 - kSteadyRadius, y = 0.5 - kSteadyRadius * 0.55 },
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
        }
        local idleX, idleY, idleTangentX, idleTangentY =
            mt.path.catmull_rom(idleWaypoints, loopProgress)
        local idleRotation = math.deg(math.atan(idleTangentY, idleTangentX)) * 0.35

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: different Bezier exit (not intro reversed)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroP0 = { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 }
        local outroP1 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide * 0.25, y = 0.5 + 0.06 }
        local outroP2 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide * 0.7, y = 0.5 + exitDrop * 0.4 }
        local outroP3 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide, y = 0.5 + exitDrop }
        local outroX, outroY, outroTangentX, outroTangentY =
            mt.path.bezier(outroP0, outroP1, outroP2, outroP3, outroEased)
        local outroRotation = math.deg(math.atan(outroTangentY, outroTangentX))

        -- Pick the active block pose (do not cross-lerp path samples —
        -- that would leave the curve). Outro wins, then intro, else idle.
        local pathX = idleX
        local pathY = idleY
        local rotation = idleRotation
        if outroEased > 0.0 then
            pathX = outroX
            pathY = outroY
            rotation = outroRotation
        elseif introEased < 1.0 then
            pathX = introX
            pathY = introY
            rotation = introRotation
        end

        character.offset_x = pathX
        character.offset_y = pathY
        character.rotation = rotation
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 2.5) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw))
        character.scale = 1.0 + (1.0 - introEased) * 0.2 + outroEased * 0.15

        -- Cool comet trail palette; brighter while still airborne on the arc.
        local airAmount = (1.0 - introEased) + outroEased
        local baseColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kTrailHue + order * 0.08, 0.35, 0.88, 1.0)
        local hotColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kTrailHue - 0.08, 0.55, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(baseColor, hotColor, mt.saturate(airAmount))
    end
end

Comet arc path. Each character streaks in along its own Bezier curve

title: Comet Arc
