name: 55_storyboard_keys.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Storyboard Keys
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Storyboard keyframes. Multi-beat choreography written as key tables
instead of hand-rolled segment math: a drop-bounce-settle entrance, a
short looping hold phrase, and a separate crouch-launch-fade exit.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.25
local kOutroDuration = 1.0
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerSeconds = 0.07 -- real-time cascade between characters
local kSteadyLoopSeconds = 1.6

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress
        -- Real-second stagger (not progress-scaled) so typing speed stays
        -- constant when the clip is stretched.
        local localTime = ctx.time - (index - 1) * kStaggerSeconds

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, 0.45)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, 1.0 - order, 0.4)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)
        local steadyWeight = introEased * (1.0 - outroEased)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro keys: drop → bounce → settle (localTime seconds)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.18 },
            { t = 0.4, v = 0.0, ease = "out_bounce" },
            { t = 0.85, v = 0.0 },
        }, localTime)
        local introScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.55 },
            { t = 0.35, v = 1.08, ease = "out_back" },
            { t = 0.7, v = 1.0, ease = "out_cubic" },
        }, localTime)
        local introRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = -18.0 },
            { t = 0.45, v = 4.0, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 0.8, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, localTime)
        local introColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.35, g = 0.4, b = 0.55, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.5, v = { r = 1.0, g = 0.72, b = 0.35, a = 1.0 }, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 0.95, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, localTime)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady keys: looping phrase on a cycled clock
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local steadyClock = mt.cycle(ctx.time + order * 0.25, kSteadyLoopSeconds) * kSteadyLoopSeconds
        local steadyOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.4, v = 0.012, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = 0.9, v = -0.006, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.5, v = 3.5, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 1.0 },
            { t = 0.55, v = 1.04, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 1.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.7, v = { r = 0.55, g = 0.78, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro keys: crouch → launch (outro-local seconds)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Map outroRaw 0–1 onto a fixed 0–1 second key window so the
        -- phrase always completes at clip end regardless of clip length.
        local outroClock = outroEased * 1.0
        local outroOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.25, v = -0.02, ease = "in_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = 0.28, ease = "in_back" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 1.0 },
            { t = 0.3, v = 0.88, ease = "in_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = 1.25, ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 1.0, v = 22.0 * (((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0), ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.45, v = { r = 0.75, g = 0.55, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = { r = 0.25, g = 0.3, b = 0.55, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)

        -- Block composite: intro pose → steady phrase → outro launch.
        local offsetY = introOffsetY
        local scale = introScale
        local rotation = introRotation
        local fillColor = introColor

        offsetY = mt.lerp(offsetY, steadyOffsetY, steadyWeight)
        scale = mt.lerp(scale, steadyScale, steadyWeight)
        rotation = mt.lerp(rotation, steadyRotation, steadyWeight)
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, steadyColor, steadyWeight)

        offsetY = mt.lerp(offsetY, outroOffsetY, outroEased)
        scale = mt.lerp(scale, outroScale, outroEased)
        rotation = mt.lerp(rotation, outroRotation, outroEased)
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, outroColor, outroEased)

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + offsetY
        character.offset_x = 0.5
        character.scale = scale
        character.rotation = rotation
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 3.0) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw))

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = fillColor
    end
end
description:
Storyboard keyframes. Multi-beat choreography written as key tables
instead of hand-rolled segment math: a drop-bounce-settle entrance, a
short looping hold phrase, and a separate crouch-launch-fade exit.

name: 57_newtons_cradle.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Newtons Cradle
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Newton's cradle. End characters swing from raised pivots while a brief
compression and color impulse crosses the stationary middle characters
and transfers the motion to the opposite end.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.0
local kIntroPullDuration = 0.7 -- seconds to pull the first end to its apex
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0

local kSwingLegDuration = 0.4 -- seconds between the contact point and apex
local kTransferDelayPerCharacter = 0.018 -- contact delay across one character
local kImpactDuration = 0.12 -- seconds of compression at each contact
local kMaximumSwingDegrees = 40.0
local kGlyphRotationRatio = 0.65 -- visible tilt relative to the pendulum angle
local kCableLength = 0.12 -- canvas-height radius of the pendulum arc
local kImpactSquash = 0.18
local kAssemblyLift = 0.07 -- canvas-height starting lift of the whole cradle

local function getFullSwingAngle(time, startTime, direction, swingLegDuration)
    -- One half-sine describes the complete physical leg: rest to apex and
    -- back to impact, without separate outbound and return keyframes.
    local duration = swingLegDuration * 2.0
    local active = time >= startTime and time <= startTime + duration
    local angle = 0.0
    if active then
        local progress = mt.saturate((time - startTime) / duration)
        angle = direction * kMaximumSwingDegrees * math.sin(progress * math.pi)
    end
    return angle
end

local function getRightSwingAngle(time, outboundStart, swingLegDuration)
    -- The cycle boundary is the right apex: first return to impact, then wait
    -- for the opposite transfer before swinging back out to the same apex.
    local angle = 0.0
    if time < swingLegDuration then
        local progress = time / swingLegDuration
        angle = kMaximumSwingDegrees * math.cos(progress * math.pi * 0.5)
    elseif time >= outboundStart then
        local progress = mt.saturate(
            (time - outboundStart) / swingLegDuration)
        angle = kMaximumSwingDegrees * math.sin(progress * math.pi * 0.5)
    end
    return angle
end

local function getFittedSchedule(ctx, characterCount)
    -- Fit an integer number of impact-to-impact transfers into the available
    -- hold, so the outro always begins exactly when an end reaches contact.
    local clipDuration = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local outroStart = math.max(kIntroDuration, clipDuration - kOutroDuration)
    local motionDuration = math.max(outroStart - kIntroDuration, 0.0)
    local transferDuration =
        math.max(characterCount - 1, 0) * kTransferDelayPerCharacter
    local baseImpactInterval = 2.0 * kSwingLegDuration + transferDuration
    local impactTransferCount = math.max(0, math.floor(
        (motionDuration - kSwingLegDuration) / baseImpactInterval + 0.5))
    local fittedSwingLegDuration = kSwingLegDuration
    if motionDuration > 0.0 then
        fittedSwingLegDuration = math.max(
            motionDuration - impactTransferCount * transferDuration,
            0.001) / (1.0 + impactTransferCount * 2.0)
    end
    return outroStart,
        motionDuration,
        transferDuration,
        fittedSwingLegDuration,
        impactTransferCount
end

local function getImpactPulse(progress)
    -- stagger_pattern stays at zero before arrival and one after recovery,
    -- so a sine turns its normalized window into one compact contact pulse.
    return math.sin(progress * math.pi)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(
        ctx,
        kIntroDuration,
        kOutroDuration,
        kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = ctx.char_count
    local outroStart,
        motionDuration,
        transferDuration,
        swingLegDuration,
        impactTransferCount = getFittedSchedule(ctx, characterCount)
    local activeTime = math.max(ctx.time - kIntroDuration, 0.0)
    local mainTime = math.min(activeTime, motionDuration)
    local cycleDuration = 4.0 * swingLegDuration + 2.0 * transferDuration
    local cycleTime = mainTime % cycleDuration

    local rightImpactTime = swingLegDuration
    local leftSwingStart = rightImpactTime + transferDuration
    local leftImpactTime = leftSwingStart + swingLegDuration * 2.0
    local rightSwingOutStart = leftImpactTime + transferDuration
    local timeSinceLeftImpact = cycleTime - leftImpactTime
    if timeSinceLeftImpact < 0.0 then
        timeSinceLeftImpact = timeSinceLeftImpact + cycleDuration
    end
    local rightAngle = getRightSwingAngle(
        cycleTime,
        rightSwingOutStart,
        swingLegDuration)
    local leftAngle = getFullSwingAngle(
        cycleTime,
        leftSwingStart,
        -1.0,
        swingLegDuration)
    local pullProgress = mt.saturate(ctx.time / kIntroPullDuration)
    local pullEased = mt.ease.in_out_sine(pullProgress)
    local introActive = ctx.time < kIntroDuration
    local outroActive = ctx.time >= outroStart
    if introActive then
        rightAngle = kMaximumSwingDegrees * pullEased
        leftAngle = 0.0
    elseif outroActive then
        rightAngle = 0.0
        leftAngle = 0.0
    end

    local outroElapsed = math.max(ctx.time - outroStart, 0.0)
    local fadeStart = math.min(
        transferDuration + kImpactDuration,
        kOutroDuration * 0.55)
    local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate(
        (outroElapsed - fadeStart)
            / math.max(kOutroDuration - fadeStart, 0.001)))
    local assemblyOffset = kAssemblyLift
        * mt.spring(ctx.time, 2.0, 5.0)
        * (1.0 - introAmount)

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local rightShockProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
            cycleTime - rightImpactTime,
            index,
            characterCount,
            "desc",
            kTransferDelayPerCharacter,
            kImpactDuration)
        local leftShockProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
            timeSinceLeftImpact,
            index,
            characterCount,
            "asc",
            kTransferDelayPerCharacter,
            kImpactDuration)
        local shockPulse = math.max(
            getImpactPulse(rightShockProgress),
            getImpactPulse(leftShockProgress))
        if introActive then
            shockPulse = 0.0
        elseif outroActive then
            local finalPattern = "desc"
            if impactTransferCount % 2 == 1 then
                finalPattern = "asc"
            end
            local finalShockProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
                outroElapsed,
                index,
                characterCount,
                finalPattern,
                kTransferDelayPerCharacter,
                kImpactDuration)
            shockPulse = getImpactPulse(finalShockProgress)
        end

        local swingAngle = 0.0
        if characterCount == 1 then
            if introActive then
                swingAngle = rightAngle
            elseif outroActive then
                swingAngle = 0.0
            else
                swingAngle = mt.wave(
                    activeTime,
                    1.0 / (4.0 * swingLegDuration),
                    math.pi * 0.5) * kMaximumSwingDegrees
                shockPulse = mt.falloff(
                    swingAngle / kMaximumSwingDegrees,
                    0.12)
            end
        elseif index == 1 then
            swingAngle = leftAngle
        elseif index == characterCount then
            swingAngle = rightAngle
        end

        if index == 1 or index == characterCount then
            -- Place the glyph center on an explicit pendulum arc. Using the
            -- canvas helpers keeps the radius correct under global transforms.
            local restingX, restingY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            local visibleSwingDegrees = swingAngle
            local visibleAngle = math.rad(visibleSwingDegrees)
            local targetX = restingX + kCableLength * math.sin(visibleAngle)
            local targetY = restingY
                + kCableLength * (1.0 - math.cos(visibleAngle))
            character.rotation = character.rotation
                - visibleSwingDegrees * kGlyphRotationRatio
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, targetX, targetY)
        end

        local squash = shockPulse * kImpactSquash
        character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * (1.0 - squash)
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (1.0 + squash * 0.35)

        local baseColor, fillMode = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, character)
        if fillMode ~= "transparent" and shockPulse > 0.0 then
            -- Gradient End Color doubles as an inspector-defined impact color
            -- even when the rendered gradient itself is disabled.
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(
                baseColor,
                ctx.global.gradient.end_color,
                mt.saturate(shockPulse))
        end

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + assemblyOffset
        character.opacity = character.opacity
            * mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount)
            * (1.0 - fadeOut)
    end
end
description:
Newton's cradle. End characters swing from raised pivots while a brief
compression and color impulse crosses the stationary middle characters
and transfers the motion to the opposite end.
title: Newtons Cradle
author: Mug

name: 58_manual_timing_table.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 4.5
-- @title Manual Timing Table
-- @recommend text "Hey there, hold on"
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Karaoke / lyric-video timing table. Each character reads its own cue
time out of kRevealSeconds -- a hand-written cue sheet in real clip
seconds -- and animates independently, so cues can repeat, skip
characters or land out of reading order.
]]

-- Lyric line: "Hey there, hold on"
--             123456789...
local kRevealSeconds = {
    [1] = 0.0, -- "H"ey -- line starts on the beat
    [4] = 0.9, -- t"h"ere -- next word lands on beat 2
    [11] = 2.0, -- "h"old -- held back for a pause after the comma
    [16] = 2.9, -- "o"n -- closing word, quick landing
}
local kDefaultStep = 0.09 -- fallback per-character pace between explicit cues
local kPopDuration = 0.22 -- seconds each character takes to settle in
local kPopScale = 0.4 -- overshoot amount at the moment a character lands

-- Time character `index` appears: explicit cues from kRevealSeconds, with
-- kDefaultStep filling every gap (before the first cue, between cues, and
-- past the last cue).
local function revealTimeFor(index)
    local precedingIndex = 0
    local precedingTime = 0.0
    for cueIndex, cueTime in pairs(kRevealSeconds) do
        if cueIndex <= index and cueIndex > precedingIndex then
            precedingIndex = cueIndex
            precedingTime = cueTime
        end
    end
    return precedingTime + (index - precedingIndex) * kDefaultStep
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    -- Each character is driven purely by its own cue time from the table
    -- above: no write_on reveal fraction, no shared forward-only cursor.
    -- A character with an earlier cue than its neighbor can pop in after
    -- it, or two characters can share the same cue and land together.
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local secondsSinceReveal = ctx.time - revealTimeFor(index)

        -- Hidden entirely until its own cue time arrives.
        local isRevealed = secondsSinceReveal >= 0.0
        local settle = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate(secondsSinceReveal / kPopDuration))

        character.opacity = isRevealed and 1.0 or 0.0
        character.scale = 1.0 + (1.0 - settle) * kPopScale
    end
end

name: 59_dialogue_cue.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5.0
-- @recommend lang ja pos 0.5 0.18 bg checkerboard #55616d
-- @recommend text "Meet me at the last station."
-- @title Dialogue Cue
-- @author Mug
-- @version 2.2
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Broadcast dialogue cue. An accent signal opens a tinted caption card,
short character groups lock into place, the line holds still for
reading, then text and card retract together in a compact reverse wipe.
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0
local kOutroDuration = 0.64

local kSignalDuration = 0.26
local kCardDelay = 0.1
local kCardDuration = 0.38
local kTextDelay = 0.28
local kTextSettleDuration = 0.24
local kGroupSize = 3
local kGroupDelay = 0.055

local kTextSlideDistance = 0.028
local kIntroStretchX = 0.68
local kLandingColorAmount = 0.68

local kTextOutDuration = 0.2
local kTextOutDelay = 0.018
local kTextOutDistance = 0.032
local kCardOutDelay = 0.18
local kCardOutDuration = 0.34

local kCardMarginX = 26.0
local kCardMarginY = 18.0
local kCardOpacity = 0.86
local kCardDarkAnchor = { r = 0.012, g = 0.016, b = 0.028, a = 1.0 }
local kCardDarkenAmount = 0.84
local kSignalWidth = 6.0

local function isVisibleCharacter(character)
    return mt.text.classify(character.text) ~= "space"
end

local function measureVisibleText(ctx)
    local minimumEdgeY = 0.5
    local maximumEdgeY = 0.5
    local hasVisibleCharacter = false
    local visibleCharacterCount = 0

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if isVisibleCharacter(character) then
            local geometry = character.geometry
            local bottomEdge = geometry.bounds_center_y - geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
            local topEdge = geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
            if hasVisibleCharacter then
                minimumEdgeY = math.min(minimumEdgeY, bottomEdge)
                maximumEdgeY = math.max(maximumEdgeY, topEdge)
            else
                minimumEdgeY = bottomEdge
                maximumEdgeY = topEdge
                hasVisibleCharacter = true
            end
            visibleCharacterCount = visibleCharacterCount + 1
        end
    end

    return minimumEdgeY, maximumEdgeY, visibleCharacterCount, hasVisibleCharacter
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local minimumEdgeY, maximumEdgeY, visibleCharacterCount, hasVisibleCharacter =
        measureVisibleText(ctx)
    local remainingSeconds = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local outroElapsed = math.max(kOutroDuration - remainingSeconds, 0.0)

    local signalIn = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate(ctx.time / kSignalDuration))
    local cardIn = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate(
        (ctx.time - kCardDelay) / kCardDuration))
    local cardOut = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate(
        (outroElapsed - kCardOutDelay) / kCardOutDuration))
    local cardOpenAmount = mt.saturate(cardIn * (1.0 - cardOut))

    -- A bottom-anchored box turns the left edge into a short cue signal.
    -- Opening the shared bounds first lets the signal lead the card fill.
    local fontSizePixels = (ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) * ctx.canvas.height
    local textHeightPixels = (maximumEdgeY - minimumEdgeY) * ctx.canvas.height
    local collapsedMarginY =
        -textHeightPixels / math.max(fontSizePixels, 1.0) * 50.0
    local boxOpenAmount = mt.saturate(signalIn * (1.0 - cardOut))
    local animatedMarginY = mt.lerp(collapsedMarginY, kCardMarginY, boxOpenAmount)
    local bottomAnchorOffsetY = kCardMarginY - animatedMarginY

    local baseColor = ctx.global.fill.color
    local accentColor = ctx.global.gradient.end_color
    local cardColor = mt.color.lerp(baseColor, kCardDarkAnchor, kCardDarkenAmount)

    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = hasVisibleCharacter and boxOpenAmount > 0.0
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_top = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_bottom = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_right = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_left = true
    ctx.bounding_box.color = accentColor
    ctx.bounding_box.width = kSignalWidth * signalIn * (1.0 - cardOut)
    ctx.bounding_box.start_cap = "round"
    ctx.bounding_box.end_cap = "round"
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_x = kCardMarginX
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_y = animatedMarginY
    ctx.bounding_box.stroke_offset_y = bottomAnchorOffsetY
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_color = cardColor
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_opacity = kCardOpacity * cardOpenAmount
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_offset_x = -(1.0 - cardOpenAmount) * kTextSlideDistance
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_offset_y = bottomAnchorOffsetY

    local safeVisibleCount = math.max(visibleCharacterCount, 1)
    local groupCount = math.max(math.ceil(safeVisibleCount / kGroupSize), 1)
    local visibleOrder = 0

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local visible = isVisibleCharacter(character)
        if visible then
            visibleOrder = visibleOrder + 1
        end

        local groupIndex = math.floor((math.max(visibleOrder, 1) - 1) / kGroupSize) + 1
        local landingProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
            ctx.time - kTextDelay,
            groupIndex,
            groupCount,
            "asc",
            kGroupDelay,
            kTextSettleDuration)
        local landing = mt.ease.out_back(landingProgress)
        local landingFlash = math.sin(landingProgress * math.pi)

        local exitProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
            outroElapsed,
            index,
            math.max(ctx.char_count, 1),
            "desc",
            kTextOutDelay,
            kTextOutDuration)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(exitProgress)

        character.offset_x = 0.5
            - (1.0 - landing) * kTextSlideDistance
            - exit * kTextOutDistance
        character.stretch_x = mt.lerp(kIntroStretchX, 1.0, landing)
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(landingProgress * 2.2) * (1.0 - exitProgress)

        local resolvedColor, fillMode = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, character)
        if fillMode ~= "transparent" then
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(
                resolvedColor,
                accentColor,
                landingFlash * kLandingColorAmount)
        end
    end
end
description:
Broadcast dialogue cue. An accent signal opens a tinted caption card,
short character groups lock into place, the line holds still for
reading, then text and card retract together in a compact reverse wipe.
title: Dialogue Cue
author: Mug

name: 60_opal_loom.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @required 3d
-- @title Opal Loom
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Opal loom. Every glyph part is a shard of polarized opal: the shards
open radially like a rose window, shimmer with iridescent interference
under a quiet camera orbit, then are woven into a two-strand aurora
ribbon and disappear down the finished thread.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.45
local kOutroDuration = 1.2
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kIntroStaggerAmount = 0.42
local kOutroStaggerAmount = 0.32

local kFoldScale = 0.12
local kFoldRotationTurns = 0.42
local kFoldDepth = 0.42
local kFoldSideDrift = 0.025
local kEdgeOnMinimum = 72.0
local kEdgeOnMaximum = 104.0

local kCameraYawAmplitude = 5.0
local kCameraPitchAmplitude = 2.4
local kCameraYawFrequency = 0.09
local kCameraPitchFrequency = 0.13
local kCameraPerspective = 0.24
local kCameraZoom = 1.03

local kInterferenceScalePrimary = 13.0
local kInterferenceScaleSecondary = 17.0
local kInterferenceSpeedPrimary = 1.35
local kInterferenceSpeedSecondary = 0.92
local kHueBase = 0.57
local kHueSpatialRange = 0.19
local kHueDriftSpeed = 0.025
local kCausticSharpness = 5.0
local kFacetDepth = 0.028
local kFacetTilt = 5.5

local kStrokeWidth = 0.006
local kStrokeGap = 0.001
local kStrokeDark = { r = 0.045, g = 0.055, b = 0.09, a = 0.92 }
local kStrokeGlint = { r = 1.0, g = 0.86, b = 0.55, a = 0.98 }

local kRibbonLeft = 0.12
local kRibbonRight = 0.88
local kRibbonAmplitude = 0.052
local kRibbonTurns = 1.35
local kRibbonPhaseSpeed = 0.55
local kRibbonStretchX = 0.24
local kRibbonStretchY = 0.055
local kRibbonDepth = -0.18
local kRibbonEdgeOn = 82.0
local kRibbonFadeStart = 0.68

local kTwoPi = math.pi * 2.0
local kCenterEpsilon = 1e-5

local function rotateAspectCorrected(positionX, positionY, angle, aspectRatio)
    local worldPositionX = positionX * aspectRatio
    local cosine = math.cos(angle)
    local sine = math.sin(angle)
    local rotatedWorldX = worldPositionX * cosine - positionY * sine
    local rotatedPositionY = worldPositionX * sine + positionY * cosine
    return rotatedWorldX / aspectRatio, rotatedPositionY
end

local function sharpenPositiveWave(value)
    return math.max(value, 0.0) ^ kCausticSharpness
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local settledAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    ctx.camera.yaw = mt.wave(ctx.time, kCameraYawFrequency, 0.0)
        * kCameraYawAmplitude
        * settledAmount
    ctx.camera.pitch = mt.wave(ctx.time, kCameraPitchFrequency, 0.25)
        * kCameraPitchAmplitude
        * settledAmount
    ctx.camera.perspective = kCameraPerspective
    ctx.camera.zoom = kCameraZoom

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.05, g = 0.16, b = 0.32, a = 0.5 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local partCount = math.max(ctx.part_count, 1)
    local aspectRatio = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local instanceSeed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local ribbonPhase = ctx.time * kRibbonPhaseSpeed

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry
        local partOrder = mt.distribute(index, partCount)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Bloom: unfold a character-local opal rose window
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introStagger =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index, 0.0, kIntroStaggerAmount)
        local introProgress = mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + introStagger) - introStagger)
        local bloomAmount = mt.ease.out_back(introProgress)

        local localPositionX = geometry.local_center_x
        local localPositionY = geometry.local_center_y
        local localDistance =
            math.sqrt(localPositionX * localPositionX + localPositionY * localPositionY)
        local fallbackAngle =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index + partCount, 0.0, kTwoPi)
        local radialAngle = fallbackAngle
        if localDistance > kCenterEpsilon then
            radialAngle = math.atan(localPositionY, localPositionX * aspectRatio)
        end

        local foldDirection =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index + partCount * 2, 0.0, 1.0) < 0.5 and -1.0 or 1.0
        local foldAngle = foldDirection * kFoldRotationTurns * kTwoPi
        local foldedPositionX, foldedPositionY = rotateAspectCorrected(
            localPositionX * kFoldScale,
            localPositionY * kFoldScale,
            foldAngle,
            aspectRatio
        )
        foldedPositionX = foldedPositionX + math.cos(radialAngle) * kFoldSideDrift
        foldedPositionY = foldedPositionY + math.sin(radialAngle) * kFoldSideDrift

        local bloomPositionX = mt.lerp(foldedPositionX, localPositionX, bloomAmount)
        local bloomPositionY = mt.lerp(foldedPositionY, localPositionY, bloomAmount)
        local bloomOffsetX = bloomPositionX - localPositionX
        local bloomOffsetY = bloomPositionY - localPositionY

        local edgeOnAngle = mt.random_range(
            instanceSeed,
            index + partCount * 3,
            kEdgeOnMinimum,
            kEdgeOnMaximum
        )
        local introYaw = foldDirection * edgeOnAngle * (1.0 - bloomAmount)
        local introPitch = -foldDirection * edgeOnAngle * 0.55 * (1.0 - bloomAmount)
        local introRotation = math.deg(foldAngle) * (1.0 - bloomAmount)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Living glass: moving polarized interference and caustics
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local worldPositionX = (geometry.canvas_center_x - 0.5) * aspectRatio
        local worldPositionY = geometry.canvas_center_y - 0.5
        local interferencePrimary = math.sin(
            worldPositionX * kInterferenceScalePrimary
                + worldPositionY * kInterferenceScalePrimary * 0.62
                - ctx.time * kInterferenceSpeedPrimary
                + fallbackAngle
        )
        local interferenceSecondary = math.sin(
            -worldPositionX * kInterferenceScaleSecondary * 0.48
                + worldPositionY * kInterferenceScaleSecondary
                + ctx.time * kInterferenceSpeedSecondary
        )
        local interference = (interferencePrimary + interferenceSecondary) * 0.25 + 0.5
        local caustic = sharpenPositiveWave(interferencePrimary * interferenceSecondary)
        local hue = mt.wrap(
            kHueBase
                + (interference - 0.5) * kHueSpatialRange
                + partOrder * 0.08
                + ctx.time * kHueDriftSpeed,
            0.0,
            1.0
        )

        local deepOpal = mt.color.from_oklch(0.5, 0.15, hue, 1.0)
        local livingOpal = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78 + interference * 0.1, 0.18, hue, 1.0)
        local pearlGlint = mt.color.from_oklch(0.985, 0.025, hue, 1.0)
        local settledColor = mt.color.lerp(deepOpal, livingOpal, bloomAmount)
        local opalColor = mt.color.lerp(settledColor, pearlGlint, caustic)

        local idleYaw = interferencePrimary * kFacetTilt * bloomAmount
        local idlePitch = interferenceSecondary * kFacetTilt * bloomAmount
        local idleDepth = -caustic * kFacetDepth * bloomAmount

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Loom: weave every facet into a two-strand aurora ribbon
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroStagger = (1.0 - partOrder) * kOutroStaggerAmount
        local outroProgress = mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroStagger) - outroStagger)
        local weaveAmount = mt.ease.in_out_cubic(outroProgress)
        local strandDirection = (index % 2 == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local strandAngle = (partOrder * kRibbonTurns + ribbonPhase) * kTwoPi
        local ribbonPositionX = mt.lerp(kRibbonLeft, kRibbonRight, partOrder)
        local ribbonPositionY =
            0.5 + math.sin(strandAngle) * kRibbonAmplitude * strandDirection
        local ribbonOffsetX = ribbonPositionX - geometry.canvas_center_x
        local ribbonOffsetY = ribbonPositionY - geometry.canvas_center_y
        local ribbonSlope = math.cos(strandAngle)
            * kRibbonAmplitude
            * strandDirection
            * kRibbonTurns
            * kTwoPi
            / ((kRibbonRight - kRibbonLeft) * aspectRatio)
        local ribbonRotation = -math.deg(math.atan(ribbonSlope))
        local ribbonFlare = mt.smoothstep(0.18, 0.62, weaveAmount)
            * (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.62, 1.0, weaveAmount))

        part.offset_x = 0.5 + mt.lerp(bloomOffsetX, ribbonOffsetX, weaveAmount)
        part.offset_y = 0.5 + mt.lerp(bloomOffsetY, ribbonOffsetY, weaveAmount)
        part.rotation = mt.lerp(introRotation, ribbonRotation, weaveAmount)
        part.yaw = mt.lerp(introYaw + idleYaw, strandDirection * kRibbonEdgeOn, weaveAmount)
        part.pitch = mt.lerp(introPitch + idlePitch, 0.0, weaveAmount)
        part.z = mt.lerp((1.0 - bloomAmount) * kFoldDepth + idleDepth, kRibbonDepth, weaveAmount)
        part.scale = mt.lerp(kFoldScale + (1.0 - kFoldScale) * bloomAmount, 1.0, weaveAmount)
        part.stretch_x = mt.lerp(1.0, kRibbonStretchX, weaveAmount)
        part.stretch_y = mt.lerp(1.0, kRibbonStretchY, weaveAmount)

        local introOpacity = mt.saturate(introProgress * 4.0)
        local outroOpacity = 1.0
            - mt.smoothstep(kRibbonFadeStart, 1.0, outroProgress)
        part.opacity = introOpacity * outroOpacity

        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(opalColor, pearlGlint, ribbonFlare)
        part.stroke.use = true
        part.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
        part.stroke.gap = kStrokeGap
        part.stroke.color = mt.color.lerp(kStrokeDark, kStrokeGlint, caustic + ribbonFlare)
        part.shadow.use = true
        part.shadow.color = mt.color.with_alpha(opalColor, 0.28 + caustic * 0.32)
    end
end
description:
Opal loom. Every glyph part is a shard of polarized opal: the shards
open radially like a rose window, shimmer with iridescent interference
under a quiet camera orbit, then are woven into a two-strand aurora
ribbon and disappear down the finished thread.
title: Opal Loom
author: Mug

name: 61_ghost_ink_lyrics.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 7.0
-- @recommend fill #d8d4f2
-- @recommend gradient #ff4f9a
-- @title Ghost Ink Lyrics
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Ghost ink lyrics. The whole line arrives as faint ghost ink so the
phrase can be anticipated, each word then blooms in sequence with a
traveling color flare and settles into calm pearl lettering, and the
finished phrase exhales upward in word order at the end of the clip.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.85
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kFallbackClipLength = 7.0
local kIntroCenterStagger = 0.38
local kOutroWordStagger = 0.42

local kGhostOpacity = 0.2
local kSungOpacity = 0.78
local kActiveOpacityBoost = 0.22
local kIntroRiseDistance = 0.035
local kActiveLift = 0.018
local kOutroLift = 0.09
local kOutroSpread = 0.035
local kActiveScale = 0.12
local kActiveTracking = 0.008
local kIntroTracking = 0.04
local kOutroTracking = 0.055
local kIntroStretchY = 0.12
local kOutroRotation = 5.0

local kLetterSweepSpan = 0.58
local kLetterSweepOffset = 0.2
local kFlareWidth = 0.2
local kFlareSharpness = 2.0

local kGhostBrightness = 0.3
local kGhostAccentAmount = 0.16
local kActiveAccentMinimum = 0.58
local kActiveAccentRange = 0.28
local kFlareBrightness = 1.45
local kShadowAlpha = 0.5
local kStrokeWidth = 0.004
local kStrokeGap = 0.0

local function scaleColorBrightness(color, brightness)
    return {
        r = mt.saturate(color.r * brightness),
        g = mt.saturate(color.g * brightness),
        b = mt.saturate(color.b * brightness),
        a = color.a,
    }
end

-- mt.text.classify also recognises the ideographic space, which a plain
-- "%s" pattern would miss in Japanese lyrics.
local function isWhitespace(text)
    return mt.text.classify(text) == "space"
end

local function buildLyricTokens(ctx)
    local containsWhitespace = false
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if isWhitespace(character.text) then
            containsWhitespace = true
        end
    end

    local tokenByCharacter = {}
    local tokenStartByCharacter = {}
    local tokenEndByCharacter = {}
    local tokenCount = 0

    if containsWhitespace then
        local currentTokenStart = 0
        for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
            if isWhitespace(character.text) then
                if currentTokenStart > 0 then
                    for tokenCharacterIndex = currentTokenStart, index - 1 do
                        tokenStartByCharacter[tokenCharacterIndex] = currentTokenStart
                        tokenEndByCharacter[tokenCharacterIndex] = index - 1
                    end
                end
                tokenByCharacter[index] = 0
                currentTokenStart = 0
            else
                if currentTokenStart == 0 then
                    tokenCount = tokenCount + 1
                    currentTokenStart = index
                end
                tokenByCharacter[index] = tokenCount
            end
        end

        if currentTokenStart > 0 then
            for tokenCharacterIndex = currentTokenStart, ctx.char_count do
                tokenStartByCharacter[tokenCharacterIndex] = currentTokenStart
                tokenEndByCharacter[tokenCharacterIndex] = ctx.char_count
            end
        end
    else
        for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
            tokenCount = tokenCount + 1
            tokenByCharacter[index] = tokenCount
            tokenStartByCharacter[index] = index
            tokenEndByCharacter[index] = index
        end
    end

    return tokenByCharacter, tokenStartByCharacter, tokenEndByCharacter, tokenCount
end

local function getCharacterOrderInToken(index, tokenStartIndex, tokenEndIndex)
    local characterOrder = 0.5
    if tokenEndIndex > tokenStartIndex then
        characterOrder = (index - tokenStartIndex) / (tokenEndIndex - tokenStartIndex)
    end
    return characterOrder
end

local function getFlareAmount(tokenProgress, characterOrder)
    local flarePosition =
        kLetterSweepOffset + characterOrder * kLetterSweepSpan
    local flareDistance = (tokenProgress - flarePosition) / kFlareWidth
    return math.exp(-(flareDistance * flareDistance)) ^ kFlareSharpness
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    ctx.global.tracking = mt.lerp(kIntroTracking, kActiveTracking, mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount))
        + mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount) * (kOutroTracking - kActiveTracking)

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 0.85
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 112.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color =
        mt.color.with_alpha(ctx.global.gradient.end_color, kShadowAlpha)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local tokenByCharacter, tokenStartByCharacter, tokenEndByCharacter, tokenCount =
        buildLyricTokens(ctx)
    local safeTokenCount = math.max(tokenCount, 1)
    local safeCharacterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local clipDuration = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local singingDuration = math.max(clipDuration - kIntroDuration - kOutroDuration, 0.001)
    local singingProgress = mt.saturate((ctx.time - kIntroDuration) / singingDuration)
    local baseColor = ctx.global.fill.color
    local accentColor = ctx.global.gradient.end_color
    local darkBaseColor = scaleColorBrightness(baseColor, kGhostBrightness)
    local ghostColor = mt.color.lerp(darkBaseColor, accentColor, kGhostAccentAmount)
    local flareColor = scaleColorBrightness(accentColor, kFlareBrightness)

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local tokenIndex = tokenByCharacter[index] or 0
        local characterOrder = mt.distribute(index, safeCharacterCount)
        local centerDistance = characterOrder * 2.0 - 1.0

        if tokenIndex == 0 then
            character.opacity = 0.0
        else
            local tokenOrder = mt.distribute(tokenIndex, safeTokenCount)
            local tokenStartProgress = (tokenIndex - 1) / safeTokenCount
            local tokenEndProgress = tokenIndex / safeTokenCount
            local tokenProgress = mt.saturate(
                (singingProgress - tokenStartProgress)
                    / math.max(tokenEndProgress - tokenStartProgress, 0.001)
            )

            local tokenStartIndex = tokenStartByCharacter[index]
            local tokenEndIndex = tokenEndByCharacter[index]
            local characterOrderInToken =
                getCharacterOrderInToken(index, tokenStartIndex, tokenEndIndex)
            local flareAmount = getFlareAmount(tokenProgress, characterOrderInToken)
            local activeAmount = math.sin(tokenProgress * math.pi)
            activeAmount = math.max(activeAmount, 0.0) ^ 0.7
            local sungAmount = mt.smoothstep(0.08, 0.82, tokenProgress)

            --------------------------------------------------------
            -- Ghost ink arrival: center characters arrive first
            --------------------------------------------------------
            local introDelay = math.abs(centerDistance) * kIntroCenterStagger
            local characterIntro = mt.ease.out_cubic(
                mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + introDelay) - introDelay)
            )

            --------------------------------------------------------
            -- Active lyric: word bloom plus a character-level flare
            --------------------------------------------------------
            local activeAccentAmount =
                kActiveAccentMinimum + tokenOrder * kActiveAccentRange
            local activeColor = mt.color.lerp(
                baseColor,
                accentColor,
                activeAccentAmount)
            local restingColor = mt.color.lerp(ghostColor, baseColor, sungAmount)
            local lyricColor = mt.color.lerp(restingColor, activeColor, activeAmount)
            lyricColor = mt.color.lerp(lyricColor, flareColor, flareAmount)

            --------------------------------------------------------
            -- Final exhale: words leave in reading order
            --------------------------------------------------------
            local outroDelay = tokenOrder * kOutroWordStagger
            local characterOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(
                mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroDelay) - outroDelay)
            )
            local exitDirection = (tokenIndex % 2 == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0

            local lyricOpacity = mt.lerp(kGhostOpacity, kSungOpacity, sungAmount)
                + activeAmount * kActiveOpacityBoost
            character.opacity = characterIntro
                * lyricOpacity
                * (1.0 - characterOutro)
            character.offset_x = 0.5 + centerDistance * kOutroSpread * characterOutro
            character.offset_y = 0.5
                - (1.0 - characterIntro) * kIntroRiseDistance
                + activeAmount * kActiveLift
                + characterOutro * kOutroLift
            character.scale = 1.0 + activeAmount * kActiveScale
            character.stretch_y = mt.lerp(kIntroStretchY, 1.0, characterIntro)
            character.rotation = exitDirection * kOutroRotation * characterOutro

            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = lyricColor
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
            character.stroke.gap = kStrokeGap
            character.stroke.color = mt.color.with_alpha(flareColor, 0.12 + flareAmount * 0.48)
            character.shadow.use = true
            character.shadow.color =
                mt.color.with_alpha(activeColor, 0.12 + activeAmount * 0.42)
        end
    end
end

Ghost ink lyrics. The whole line arrives as faint ghost ink so the
phrase can be anticipated, each word then blooms in sequence with a
traveling color flare and settles into calm pearl lettering, and the
finished phrase exhales upward in word order at the end of the clip.

name: 62_path_parade.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 8.0
-- @recommend fill #b8d6ff
-- @recommend gradient #ff7a33
-- @title Path Parade
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Path parade. Characters queue as readable text along the bottom edge,
then depart clockwise one at a time around a closed path -- braking,
turning and squashing through each corner -- and rebuild the line when
they complete the circuit.
]]

local kPathPoints = {
    { x = 0.22, y = 0.82 },
    { x = 0.78, y = 0.82 },
    { x = 0.78, y = 0.18 },
    { x = 0.22, y = 0.18 },
}

local kIntroDuration = 0.65
local kOutroDuration = 0.7
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0
local kIntroScale = 0.24
local kReadingSegmentIndex = 3
local kBottomHoldDuration = 1.15
local kDepartureStaggerSeconds = 0.16
local kMaximumDepartureWaveDuration = 1.6
local kCircuitDuration = 4.4
local kCollectedHoldDuration = 0.9
local kCornerWindow = 0.2
local kCornerBrakeStrength = 0.42
local kCornerCutDistance = 0.022
local kCornerReleaseHop = 0.012
local kCornerCompression = 0.16
local kCornerReleaseScale = 0.09
local kCornerBankDegrees = 9.0
local kBottomEdgeReadingRotation = 180.0
local kTurnEpsilon = 1e-5

local kReleaseBrightness = 1.35

local kTwoPi = math.pi * 2.0

local function getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle)
    return (endAngle - startAngle + math.pi) % kTwoPi - math.pi
end

local function interpolateAngle(startAngle, endAngle, amount)
    return startAngle + getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle) * amount
end

local function getTurnDirection(startAngle, endAngle)
    local angleDifference = getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle)
    local turnDirection = 0.0
    if angleDifference > kTurnEpsilon then
        turnDirection = 1.0
    elseif angleDifference < -kTurnEpsilon then
        turnDirection = -1.0
    end
    return turnDirection
end

local function buildPathSegments(pathPoints, aspectRatio)
    local segments = {}
    local totalLength = 0.0

    for index = 1, #pathPoints do
        local startPoint = pathPoints[index]
        local endPoint = pathPoints[index % #pathPoints + 1]
        local distanceX = (endPoint.x - startPoint.x) * aspectRatio
        local distanceY = endPoint.y - startPoint.y
        local segmentLength = math.sqrt(distanceX * distanceX + distanceY * distanceY)
        local segmentAngle = math.atan(distanceY, distanceX)

        segments[index] = {
            startPoint = startPoint,
            endPoint = endPoint,
            length = segmentLength,
            angle = segmentAngle,
            cumulativeStart = totalLength,
        }
        totalLength = totalLength + segmentLength
    end

    return segments, totalLength
end

local function applyCornerBrake(segmentProgress)
    return mt.lerp(
        segmentProgress,
        mt.smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, segmentProgress),
        kCornerBrakeStrength
    )
end

local function invertCornerBrake(targetProgress)
    local lowerBound = 0.0
    local upperBound = 1.0
    local kSearchIterations = 14

    for _ = 1, kSearchIterations do
        local midpoint = (lowerBound + upperBound) * 0.5
        if applyCornerBrake(midpoint) < targetProgress then
            lowerBound = midpoint
        else
            upperBound = midpoint
        end
    end

    return (lowerBound + upperBound) * 0.5
end

local function scaleColorBrightness(color, brightness)
    return {
        r = mt.saturate(color.r * brightness),
        g = mt.saturate(color.g * brightness),
        b = mt.saturate(color.b * brightness),
        a = color.a,
    }
end

local function captureNaturalText(ctx)
    local minimumX = 0.5
    local maximumX = 0.5
    local minimumY = 0.5
    local maximumY = 0.5
    local hasCharacter = false
    local positions = {}

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local positionX, positionY =
            mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
        positions[index] = { x = positionX, y = positionY }

        if hasCharacter then
            minimumX = math.min(minimumX, positionX)
            maximumX = math.max(maximumX, positionX)
            minimumY = math.min(minimumY, positionY)
            maximumY = math.max(maximumY, positionY)
        else
            minimumX = positionX
            maximumX = positionX
            minimumY = positionY
            maximumY = positionY
            hasCharacter = true
        end
    end

    return {
        centerX = (minimumX + maximumX) * 0.5,
        centerY = (minimumY + maximumY) * 0.5,
        positions = positions,
    }
end

local function sampleClosedPath(segments, totalLength, progress)
    local wrappedDistance = mt.wrap(progress, 0.0, 1.0) * totalLength
    local selectedSegmentIndex = 1
    local selectedSegmentProgress = 0.0
    local segmentFound = false

    for index = 1, #segments do
        local segment = segments[index]
        local cumulativeEnd = segment.cumulativeStart + segment.length
        if not segmentFound and wrappedDistance <= cumulativeEnd then
            selectedSegmentIndex = index
            selectedSegmentProgress =
                (wrappedDistance - segment.cumulativeStart) / math.max(segment.length, kTurnEpsilon)
            segmentFound = true
        end
    end

    selectedSegmentProgress = mt.saturate(selectedSegmentProgress)
    local selectedSegment = segments[selectedSegmentIndex]
    local previousSegment = segments[(selectedSegmentIndex - 2) % #segments + 1]
    local nextSegment = segments[selectedSegmentIndex % #segments + 1]

    -- A partial smoothstep keeps most of each edge moving steadily while
    -- still bringing velocity down as the character reaches a corner.
    local brakedProgress = applyCornerBrake(selectedSegmentProgress)
    local positionX =
        mt.lerp(selectedSegment.startPoint.x, selectedSegment.endPoint.x, brakedProgress)
    local positionY =
        mt.lerp(selectedSegment.startPoint.y, selectedSegment.endPoint.y, brakedProgress)

    local travelAngle = selectedSegment.angle
    local cornerAmount = 0.0
    local releaseAmount = 0.0
    local turnDirection = 0.0

    if selectedSegmentProgress < kCornerWindow then
        local cornerExitProgress =
            mt.smoothstep(0.0, kCornerWindow, selectedSegmentProgress)
        travelAngle = interpolateAngle(
            previousSegment.angle,
            selectedSegment.angle,
            0.5 + cornerExitProgress * 0.5
        )
        cornerAmount = 1.0 - cornerExitProgress
        releaseAmount = math.sin(cornerExitProgress * math.pi)
        turnDirection = getTurnDirection(previousSegment.angle, selectedSegment.angle)
    elseif selectedSegmentProgress > 1.0 - kCornerWindow then
        local cornerEntryProgress = mt.smoothstep(
            1.0 - kCornerWindow,
            1.0,
            selectedSegmentProgress
        )
        travelAngle = interpolateAngle(
            selectedSegment.angle,
            nextSegment.angle,
            cornerEntryProgress * 0.5
        )
        cornerAmount = cornerEntryProgress
        turnDirection = getTurnDirection(selectedSegment.angle, nextSegment.angle)
    end

    return {
        positionX = positionX,
        positionY = positionY,
        travelAngle = travelAngle,
        cornerAmount = cornerAmount,
        releaseAmount = releaseAmount,
        turnDirection = turnDirection,
    }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local safeCharacterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local pathSegments, totalPathLength =
        buildPathSegments(kPathPoints, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio)
    local readingSegment = pathSegments[kReadingSegmentIndex]
    local naturalText = captureNaturalText(ctx)
    local accentColor = ctx.global.gradient.end_color
    local releaseColor = scaleColorBrightness(accentColor, kReleaseBrightness)

    local departureStagger = math.min(
        kDepartureStaggerSeconds,
        kMaximumDepartureWaveDuration / math.max(safeCharacterCount - 1, 1)
    )
    local departureWaveDuration =
        math.max(safeCharacterCount - 1, 0) * departureStagger
    local cycleDuration =
        kBottomHoldDuration
            + departureWaveDuration
            + kCircuitDuration
            + kCollectedHoldDuration
    local cycleTime = ctx.time % cycleDuration

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local characterOrder = mt.distribute(index, safeCharacterCount)
        local baseCharacterScale = character.scale
        local baseCharacterStretchX = character.stretch_x
        local baseCharacterStretchY = character.stretch_y
        local baseCharacterOpacity = character.opacity
        local naturalPosition = naturalText.positions[index]

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Bottom queue: preserve the natural text's horizontal spacing
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local readableSegmentProgress =
            0.5
                - (naturalPosition.x - naturalText.centerX)
                    * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
                    / math.max(readingSegment.length, kTurnEpsilon)
        local rawReadableSegmentProgress = readableSegmentProgress
        if readableSegmentProgress >= 0.0 and readableSegmentProgress <= 1.0 then
            rawReadableSegmentProgress =
                invertCornerBrake(readableSegmentProgress)
        end
        local readingSlotProgress = (
            readingSegment.cumulativeStart
                + rawReadableSegmentProgress * readingSegment.length
        ) / totalPathLength

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- One-by-one circuit: hold, launch, orbit, collect, hold
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local departureTime =
            kBottomHoldDuration + (index - 1) * departureStagger
        local travelTime = cycleTime - departureTime
        local circuitProgress = 0.0
        if travelTime >= 0.0 and travelTime < kCircuitDuration then
            local rawCircuitProgress =
                mt.saturate(travelTime / kCircuitDuration)
            circuitProgress = mt.ease.in_out_sine(rawCircuitProgress)
        end

        local pathProgress = readingSlotProgress + circuitProgress
        local pathSample =
            sampleClosedPath(pathSegments, totalPathLength, pathProgress)

        -- For a left turn, the left-hand normal points inside the route;
        -- for a right turn, the right-hand normal does. This cuts the hard
        -- polygon corner without changing the user-authored path points.
        local inwardNormalX =
            -math.sin(pathSample.travelAngle) * pathSample.turnDirection
        local inwardNormalY =
            math.cos(pathSample.travelAngle) * pathSample.turnDirection
        local inwardDistance =
            pathSample.cornerAmount * kCornerCutDistance
                + pathSample.releaseAmount * kCornerReleaseHop
        local naturalVerticalOffset =
            naturalPosition.y - naturalText.centerY
        local rotatedNaturalOffsetX =
            math.sin(pathSample.travelAngle)
                * naturalVerticalOffset
                / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
        local rotatedNaturalOffsetY =
            -math.cos(pathSample.travelAngle) * naturalVerticalOffset
        local targetPositionX = pathSample.positionX
            + inwardNormalX * inwardDistance / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
            + rotatedNaturalOffsetX
        local targetPositionY = pathSample.positionY
            + inwardNormalY * inwardDistance
            + rotatedNaturalOffsetY

        local introDelay = characterOrder * 0.28
        local characterIntro = mt.ease.out_back(
            mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + introDelay) - introDelay)
        )
        local outroDelay = (1.0 - characterOrder) * 0.25
        local characterOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(
            mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroDelay) - outroDelay)
        )

        local cornerCompression =
            pathSample.cornerAmount * kCornerCompression
        local releaseScale =
            pathSample.releaseAmount * kCornerReleaseScale
        -- The bottom edge is the default reading edge: characters are
        -- upright there and arranged left to right while moving clockwise.
        character.rotation = -math.deg(pathSample.travelAngle)
            + kBottomEdgeReadingRotation
            - pathSample.turnDirection * kCornerBankDegrees * pathSample.cornerAmount
        character.scale =
            baseCharacterScale
                * mt.lerp(kIntroScale, 1.0, characterIntro)
                * (1.0 + releaseScale)
        character.stretch_x =
            baseCharacterStretchX * (1.0 - cornerCompression)
        character.stretch_y =
            baseCharacterStretchY * (1.0 + cornerCompression * 0.7)

        -- place_2d is called after size and rotation are final, so the
        -- character's true transformed center lands exactly on the route.
        mt.layout.place_2d(
            ctx,
            character,
            targetPositionX,
            targetPositionY
        )

        character.opacity = baseCharacterOpacity
            * mt.saturate(characterIntro * 4.0)
            * (1.0 - characterOutro)

        local baseColor, fillMode = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, character)
        if fillMode ~= "transparent" then
            local turnColor = mt.color.lerp(
                baseColor,
                accentColor,
                pathSample.cornerAmount)
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(
                turnColor,
                releaseColor,
                pathSample.releaseAmount)
        end
    end
end
description:
Path parade. Characters queue as readable text along the bottom edge,
then depart clockwise one at a time around a closed path -- braking,
turning and squashing through each corner -- and rebuild the line when
they complete the circuit.
title: Path Parade
author: Mug

name: 63_ruby_layout.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5.0
-- @recommend text "<ruby>漢字<rp>(</rp><rt>かんじ</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>にルビを<ruby>振<rp>(</rp><rt>ふ</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>る"
-- @title Ruby Layout
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 2
--[[ @description
Ruby (furigana) auto-layout from HTML markup
("<ruby>親文字<rp>(</rp><rt>ルビ</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>"). The main text is
retypeset and centered, and each ruby group is fitted above its parent
characters. Line Spacing is repurposed as the ruby/parent gap knob.
]]

-- UTF-8 character splitter helper
local function getUtf8Chars(str)
    local chars = {}
    for code in string.gmatch(str, "[%z\1-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*") do
        table.insert(chars, code)
    end
    return chars
end

-- Global cache for ruby metadata
local gCharMeta = {}
local gMainIndices = {}
local gRubyGroups = {}

local function parseRubyText(rawInputStr)
    -- Sanitize HTML5 fallback <rp>...</rp> tags first
    local inputStr = string.gsub(rawInputStr, "<rp>.-</rp>", "")

    local plainCharList = {}
    local charMeta = {}
    local mainIndices = {}
    local rubyGroups = {}

    local cursor = 1
    while cursor <= #inputStr do
        local rStart, rEnd, parentStr, rubyStr = string.find(inputStr, "<ruby>(.-)<rt>(.-)</rt></ruby>", cursor)
        if rStart then
            -- Plain text before ruby tag
            if rStart > cursor then
                local plainSub = string.sub(inputStr, cursor, rStart - 1)
                local plainChars = getUtf8Chars(plainSub)
                for _, ch in ipairs(plainChars) do
                    table.insert(plainCharList, ch)
                    local idx = #plainCharList
                    table.insert(mainIndices, idx)
                    table.insert(charMeta, { isRuby = false })
                end
            end

            local pChars = getUtf8Chars(parentStr)
            local rChars = getUtf8Chars(rubyStr)

            -- Parent kanji characters
            local pStartIdx = #plainCharList + 1
            for _, ch in ipairs(pChars) do
                table.insert(plainCharList, ch)
                local idx = #plainCharList
                table.insert(mainIndices, idx)
                table.insert(charMeta, { isRuby = false, isParent = true })
            end
            local pEndIdx = #plainCharList

            -- Ruby furigana characters
            local rIndices = {}
            for i, ch in ipairs(rChars) do
                table.insert(plainCharList, ch)
                local idx = #plainCharList
                table.insert(rIndices, idx)
                table.insert(charMeta, {
                    isRuby = true,
                    parentStart = pStartIdx,
                    parentEnd = pEndIdx,
                    rubyIndex = i,
                    rubyTotal = #rChars,
                })
            end

            table.insert(rubyGroups, {
                parentStart = pStartIdx,
                parentEnd = pEndIdx,
                rubyIndices = rIndices,
            })

            cursor = rEnd + 1
        else
            local restSub = string.sub(inputStr, cursor)
            if #restSub > 0 then
                local restChars = getUtf8Chars(restSub)
                for _, ch in ipairs(restChars) do
                    table.insert(plainCharList, ch)
                    local idx = #plainCharList
                    table.insert(mainIndices, idx)
                    table.insert(charMeta, { isRuby = false })
                end
            end
            break
        end
    end

    local fullPlainText = table.concat(plainCharList, "")
    return fullPlainText, charMeta, mainIndices, rubyGroups
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local rawText = ctx.global.text or ""
    local plainText, meta, mainIdx, rubyGrps = parseRubyText(rawText)
    gCharMeta = meta
    gMainIndices = mainIdx
    gRubyGroups = rubyGrps

    -- Materialize plain text
    ctx.global.text = plainText
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local totalChars = ctx.char_count
    if totalChars == 0 then
        return
    end

    -- Line Spacing knob repurposed as the ruby/parent gap.
    -- 1.0 = tuned default gap, 0.0 = flush against the parent.
    local rubyGapKnob = mt.clamp(ctx.global.line_spacing, 0.0, 3.0)

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 1: Retypeset main body characters & Zero-Drift Center Normalization
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if #gMainIndices > 0 then
        -- Collapse advance width of ruby glyphs so main text flows seamlessly
        for _, group in ipairs(gRubyGroups) do
            for _, rIdx in ipairs(group.rubyIndices) do
                if rIdx <= totalChars then
                    ctx.chars[rIdx].scale = 0.0001
                end
            end
        end

        local firstMainIdx = gMainIndices[1]
        mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
            targets = gMainIndices,
            anchor = firstMainIdx,
        })

        -- Calculate the unrotated 2D center of the main sentence
        local firstGeom = ctx.chars[firstMainIdx].geometry
        local lastMainIdx = gMainIndices[#gMainIndices]
        local lastGeom = ctx.chars[lastMainIdx].geometry

        local firstCenterX = firstGeom.bounds_center_x + (ctx.chars[firstMainIdx].offset_x - 0.5)
        local lastCenterX = lastGeom.bounds_center_x + (ctx.chars[lastMainIdx].offset_x - 0.5)
        local sentenceCenterX = (firstCenterX + lastCenterX) * 0.5

        -- Shift all main characters so the unrotated 2D sentence is centered
        local centerOffset = 0.5 - sentenceCenterX
        for _, mIdx in ipairs(gMainIndices) do
            if mIdx <= totalChars then
                ctx.chars[mIdx].offset_x = ctx.chars[mIdx].offset_x + centerOffset
            end
        end
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 2: Calculate approximate parent bounds and fit ruby text
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Ruby offsets are computed entirely in the parent character's natural/offset
    -- space, without ever touching ctx.global. global.rotation/scale/stretch are
    -- applied once, uniformly, to every character (main and ruby alike) after
    -- OnLayout runs -- so as long as the ruby's offset is expressed in that shared
    -- pre-global space, it automatically rotates and scales together with the
    -- parent character it sits above. Reaching into ctx.global here (as an earlier
    -- version of this sample did, via place_2d's canvas-absolute placement) fights
    -- that shared transform instead of riding along with it.
    for _, group in ipairs(gRubyGroups) do
        local parentFirstGeom = ctx.chars[group.parentStart].geometry
        local parentLastGeom = ctx.chars[group.parentEnd].geometry
        local parentFirstChar = ctx.chars[group.parentStart]
        local parentLastChar = ctx.chars[group.parentEnd]

        -- Parent block center, in natural + offset space (pre-global, canvas-normalized).
        -- Both offset_x/offset_y and bounds_center_x/y are Y-up, 0.5-centered
        -- canvas-normalized values here, so both axes add the same way. (The "-" seen
        -- in prelude.lua's layoutCharacterMatrix, offsetY = -(offset_y - 0.5) * height,
        -- only appears once offset_y is converted into Y-down pixel space -- it is not
        -- present between two values that are both already Y-up, like these two.)
        local parentFirstCenterX = parentFirstGeom.bounds_center_x + (parentFirstChar.offset_x - 0.5)
        local parentLastCenterX = parentLastGeom.bounds_center_x + (parentLastChar.offset_x - 0.5)
        local parentCenterX = (parentFirstCenterX + parentLastCenterX) * 0.5
        local parentCenterY = parentFirstGeom.bounds_center_y + (parentFirstChar.offset_y - 0.5)

        -- Natural (pre-global) block size, matching the naturalRubyGap/minRubySpan tuning
        -- below, which is likewise expressed in this same pre-global canvas-normalized unit.
        local parentBlockWidth =
            (parentLastCenterX - parentFirstCenterX) + (parentFirstGeom.bounds_width * 0.5 + parentLastGeom.bounds_width * 0.5)
        local parentBlockHeight = parentFirstGeom.bounds_height

        local rubyCount = #group.rubyIndices
        local naturalRubyGap = 0.024
        local minRubySpan = 0.012
        local maxRubySpan = math.min(parentBlockWidth * 0.85, math.max(minRubySpan, (rubyCount - 1) * naturalRubyGap))

        for i, rIdx in ipairs(group.rubyIndices) do
            if rIdx <= totalChars then
                local rubyChar = ctx.chars[rIdx]
                local rGeom = rubyChar.geometry

                -- Restore ruby font size (45%)
                rubyChar.scale = 0.45

                -- Lateral offset across the parent block
                local lateralOffset = 0.0
                if rubyCount > 1 then
                    local step = maxRubySpan / (rubyCount - 1)
                    lateralOffset = -(maxRubySpan * 0.5) + (i - 1) * step
                end

                -- Vertical offset (above the parent), in the same pre-global units.
                -- rubyMarginY is scaled by the Line Spacing knob (see OnLayout header).
                local rubyHeight = rGeom.bounds_height * 0.45
                local rubyMarginY = 0.008 * rubyGapKnob
                local verticalOffset = (parentBlockHeight * 0.5) + (rubyHeight * 0.5) + rubyMarginY

                local targetCenterX = parentCenterX + lateralOffset
                local targetCenterY = parentCenterY + verticalOffset

                -- Move the ruby's own natural center to the target by adjusting its offset
                -- directly, staying in the same pre-global space as targetCenterX/Y above
                -- (both axes add the same way here; see the note above parentCenterY).
                rubyChar.offset_x = 0.5 + targetCenterX - rGeom.bounds_center_x
                rubyChar.offset_y = 0.5 + targetCenterY - rGeom.bounds_center_y
            end
        end
    end
end
description:
Ruby (furigana) auto-layout from HTML markup
("<ruby>親文字<rp>(</rp><rt>ルビ</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>"). The main text is
retypeset and centered, and each ruby group is fitted above its parent
characters. Line Spacing is repurposed as the ruby/parent gap knob.
title: Ruby Layout
author: Mug

-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Wavefall Settle
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Characters begin on one level line, bounce into a gentle wave, then
quietly converge back into alignment while accelerating out of frame.
]]

local kDropHeight = 0.35
local kWaveAmplitude = 0.08
local kWaveFrequency = 0.9
local kIntroStagger = 0.08
local kOutroDuration = 1.35
local kExitDistance = 0.7
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local restPositions = {}
    local highestRestY = -math.huge
    local totalRestY = 0.0

    -- Measure every destination before moving any character so the entrance
    -- and exit can share level lines derived from the current inspector layout.
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local phase = mt.distribute(index, ctx.char_count)
        local waveOffset = math.sin(phase * math.pi * 2.0 * kWaveFrequency) * kWaveAmplitude
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + waveOffset

        local restX, restY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
        restPositions[index] = { x = restX, y = restY }
        highestRestY = math.max(highestRestY, restY)
        totalRestY = totalRestY + restY
    end

    local commonStartY = highestRestY + kDropHeight
    local commonExitBaseY = totalRestY / math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local _, outroProgress =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, 0.0, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local levelAmount = mt.ease.in_out_sine(outroProgress)
    local fallAmount = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress)

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local restPosition = restPositions[index]
        mt.bounce_ground(ctx, character, restPosition.y, {
            start_mode = "absolute",
            start_y = commonStartY,
            ground_mode = "absolute",
            delay = (index - 1) * kIntroStagger,
            align_to = "center",
            gravity = 5.0,
            restitution = 0.45,
            squash = 0.22,
            stretch = 0.035,
            flexibility = 18.0,
            damping = 6.5
        })

        if outroProgress > 0.0 then
            local levelY = mt.lerp(restPosition.y, commonExitBaseY, levelAmount)
            local exitY = levelY - fallAmount * kExitDistance
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, restPosition.x, exitY)
        end
    end
end
