name: 65_debris_burst.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend bg #0a0a0c
-- @title Debris Burst
-- @author Mug
-- @version 2.2
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Stress builds until the text glows white-hot, shudders, and fails.
Fragments arc into the air in 3D, tumbling past the camera as they burn out.
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0

local kIntroDuration = 1.1
local kIntroStagger = 0.45 -- fraction of the intro spread across parts
local kSettleDistance = 0.26 -- canvas fraction the parts converge from
local kSettleSpin = 220.0 -- degrees of tumble shed while converging

-- The load phase runs in two beats: the glow climbs the text until it is fully
-- saturated, then everything holds at the limit for a breath before failing.
local kOutroLead = 4.3
local kGlowDuration = 1.9
local kHoldDuration = 0.6
local kTremorFrequency = 22.0 -- shudder cycles per second at full load
local kTremorAmount = 0.0035 -- canvas fraction of the shudder at full load
local kHoldTremorBoost = 2.2 -- the shudder tightens further during the hold
local kGlowLoadShare = 0.75 -- fraction of the total strain applied by full glow
local kLoadCompression = 0.05 -- how far the text compresses under load
local kLoadTracking = 0.05 -- letters crowd together as the strain peaks

-- The heat color is the inspector's gradient end color, left untouched so the
-- effect is retintable. Only the edge between it and the untouched fill moves,
-- rising through the text from the bottom up.
local kGlowAngle = 90.0 -- top-to-bottom axis: fill above, end_color below
local kGlowMidpoint = 0.0 -- biases the ramp toward end_color for a crisp edge
local kGlowEdgeStart = 1.0 -- edge begins at the cap height, text fully cold
local kGlowEdgeEnd = -0.1 -- and is walked past the baseline, leaving it saturated
local kGlowEdgeLead = 0.3 -- how far end trails start: the softness of the edge

-- Failure is near enough simultaneous, with only a slight radial delay from the
-- epicentre so the break reads as one event spreading outward. The variety
-- lives in the flight, not the timing.
local kFailureRadialDelay = 0.09 -- seconds from the centre to the furthest part
local kBurstSpeedMin = 0.7
local kBurstSpeedMax = 1.4
local kBurstSpread = 30.0 -- degrees each fragment may deviate from its throw
-- A purely radial throw is nearly horizontal on one line of text, leaving no arc
-- to fall from. Blending toward straight up gives every fragment real lift.
local kBurstUpwardBias = 0.62 -- 0 = purely radial, 1 = straight up
local kBurstGravity = 2.6
local kBurstDrag = 0.25 -- 1/second, light air resistance that keeps the arcs
local kBurstSpin = 200.0 -- degrees per second; more turns competes with the arc
local kBurstShrink = 0.15 -- perspective already shrinks whatever recedes

-- Depth, so some fragments tumble toward the camera and others recede. Total
-- tumble angles rather than rates: each settles into an attitude and holds it,
-- keeping its silhouette readable along the arc.
local kBurstDepthNear = -0.55
local kBurstDepthFar = 0.75
local kBurstTumbleYaw = 70.0
local kBurstTumblePitch = 60.0
local kBurstTumbleRamp = 0.6 -- seconds to reach the settled attitude

local kLifetimeMin = 0.7
local kLifetimeMax = 1.5
local kFlashMin = 0.08 -- shortest white-hot flash as a fragment lets go
local kFlashMax = 0.26 -- longest flash, so the breaks read individually
local kCoolDuration = 0.55 -- seconds to fall from glowing back to the text colour
local kColorEmber = { r = 1.0, g = 0.97, b = 0.92, a = 1.0 }

---Seconds since the outro began, 0 beforehand.
local function getOutroElapsed(ctx)
    return math.max(kOutroLead - mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, kFallbackClipLength), 0.0)
end

---Progress of the heat climbing the text, reaching 1 well before failure.
local function getGlowAmount(outroElapsed)
    return mt.saturate(outroElapsed / kGlowDuration)
end

---Progress through the held breath that follows full glow.
local function getHoldAmount(outroElapsed)
    return mt.saturate((outroElapsed - kGlowDuration) / kHoldDuration)
end

---Seconds since the text gave way, still negative while it holds.
local function getFailureElapsed(outroElapsed)
    return outroElapsed - kGlowDuration - kHoldDuration
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local outroElapsed = getOutroElapsed(ctx)
    local glow = getGlowAmount(outroElapsed)
    local hold = getHoldAmount(outroElapsed)
    local heat = mt.ease.in_quad(glow)

    -- The glow takes the strain most of the way; the hold supplies the rest, so
    -- the held beat reads as mounting pressure rather than a pause.
    local load = glow * kGlowLoadShare + hold * (1.0 - kGlowLoadShare)

    ctx.global.gradient.color_space = "oklab"
    ctx.global.gradient.angle = kGlowAngle
    ctx.global.gradient.midpoint = kGlowMidpoint

    -- The position pair is the edge between cold text above and heat below.
    -- Walking it down past the baseline leaves every glyph saturated.
    local heatEdge = mt.lerp(kGlowEdgeStart, kGlowEdgeEnd, heat)
    ctx.global.gradient.start_position = heatEdge
    ctx.global.gradient.end_position = heatEdge + kGlowEdgeLead

    -- The strain only applies while the text is still intact; glow and hold both
    -- stay at 1 afterwards, so the gate is what releases the debris.
    if getFailureElapsed(outroElapsed) <= 0.0 then
        local tremor = mt.wave(ctx.time, kTremorFrequency * (1.0 + hold * kHoldTremorBoost), 0.0)
        ctx.global.position_x = ctx.global.position_x + tremor * kTremorAmount * math.max(heat, hold)
        ctx.global.tracking = ctx.global.tracking - load * kLoadTracking
        ctx.global.stretch_y = ctx.global.stretch_y * (1.0 - load * kLoadCompression)
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local introProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, 0.0, kFallbackClipLength)
    local outroElapsed = getOutroElapsed(ctx)
    local failureElapsed = getFailureElapsed(outroElapsed)
    local hold = getHoldAmount(outroElapsed)
    local load = math.max(getGlowAmount(outroElapsed), hold)

    -- Aspect corrected, so the burst stays circular on a wide comp.
    local characterRadius = {}
    local furthestRadius = 0.0
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local radius = mt.layout.radial_distance(ctx, geometry.bounds_center_x, geometry.bounds_center_y)
        characterRadius[index] = radius
        furthestRadius = math.max(furthestRadius, radius)
    end

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry

        -- Normalised so the delay stays the same regardless of text length.
        local radius = characterRadius[part.character_index]
        local radialProgress = furthestRadius > 0.0 and radius / furthestRadius or 0.0
        local sinceBurst = failureElapsed - radialProgress * kFailureRadialDelay

        if sinceBurst > 0.0 then
            -- Angles are screen based (-90 is straight up) while canvas Y is up,
            -- hence the negated vertical delta. Rotating the outward direction
            -- toward vertical keeps the left/right split while giving every
            -- fragment enough lift to arc over and fall back.
            local outwardAngle = math.deg(math.atan(0.5 - geometry.canvas_center_y, geometry.canvas_center_x - 0.5))
            local throwAngle = mt.lerp_angle(outwardAngle, -90.0, kBurstUpwardBias)

            local flight = mt.projectile_2d({
                t = sinceBurst,
                speed = mt.random_range(seed, index, kBurstSpeedMin, kBurstSpeedMax, "speed"),
                angle = throwAngle + mt.random_range(seed, index, -kBurstSpread, kBurstSpread, "spread"),
                gravity = kBurstGravity,
                drag = kBurstDrag,
                spin = mt.random_range(seed, index, -kBurstSpin, kBurstSpin, "spin"),
            })

            part.offset_x = part.offset_x + flight.x
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y + flight.y
            part.rotation = part.rotation + flight.rotation

            -- Constant rate, deliberately ungoverned by gravity: pulling Z back
            -- would flatten the spread toward the layout plane.
            part.z = part.z + mt.random_range(seed, index, kBurstDepthNear, kBurstDepthFar, "depth") * sinceBurst

            local tumble = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate(sinceBurst / kBurstTumbleRamp))
            part.yaw = part.yaw + mt.random_range(seed, index, -kBurstTumbleYaw, kBurstTumbleYaw, "yaw") * tumble
            part.pitch = part.pitch
                + mt.random_range(seed, index, -kBurstTumblePitch, kBurstTumblePitch, "pitch") * tumble

            local age = mt.saturate(sinceBurst / mt.random_range(seed, index, kLifetimeMin, kLifetimeMax, "life"))
            part.scale = part.scale * (1.0 - kBurstShrink * age)
            part.opacity = part.opacity * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(age))

            -- fill.use holds for the whole flight, since it is what keeps the
            -- fragment off the saturated gradient. Breaking away costs it the
            -- pressure that was heating it, so it flares white on release and
            -- then cools to the text's own colour.
            local flashDuration = mt.random_range(seed, index, kFlashMin, kFlashMax, "flash")
            local flash = 1.0 - mt.saturate(sinceBurst / flashDuration)
            local baseColor = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, part)
            local glowColor = ctx.global.gradient.end_color
            local cooled = mt.color.lerp(glowColor, baseColor, mt.ease.out_quad(sinceBurst / kCoolDuration))
            part.fill.use = true
            part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(cooled, kColorEmber, flash)
        elseif load > 0.0 then
            -- Still holding, but straining: fragments creak against each other
            -- with a jitter that grows right up to the breaking point.
            local jitterFrequency = kTremorFrequency * (1.0 + hold * kHoldTremorBoost)
            local jitterPhase = mt.wave(ctx.time, jitterFrequency, index * 0.13)
            local jitterAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, 360.0, "jitter")
            local jitterX, jitterY = mt.polar_offset_2d(jitterAngle, mt.ease.in_quad(load) * kTremorAmount)
            part.offset_x = part.offset_x + jitterX * jitterPhase
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y + jitterY * jitterPhase
        elseif introProgress < 1.0 then
            -- Intro: fragments converge on their glyph from a scattered ring,
            -- shedding the tumble they arrived with.
            local settle = mt.ease.out_cubic(
                mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, mt.distribute(index, ctx.part_count), kIntroStagger))
            local remaining = 1.0 - settle

            local approachAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, 360.0, "approach")
            local distance = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.5, 1.0, "distance") * kSettleDistance
            local offsetX, offsetY = mt.polar_offset_2d(approachAngle, remaining * distance)

            part.offset_x = part.offset_x + offsetX
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y + offsetY
            part.rotation = part.rotation + remaining * mt.random_range(seed, index, -kSettleSpin, kSettleSpin, "settle")
            part.opacity = part.opacity * settle
        end
    end
end
description:
Stress builds until the text glows white-hot, shudders, and fails.
Fragments arc into the air in 3D, tumbling past the camera as they burn out.
title: Debris Burst
author: Mug

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 11.0
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend text "ENDLESS-SIGNAL"
-- @recommend bg #03030A
-- @title Mobius Transmission
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Mobius transmission. Luminous fragments spiral in from deep space and
lock into a one-sided receiver. A signal circles the completed loop,
lingers, then decodes into readable text through an invisible edge-on
exchange. Sparse block interference interrupts the held message before
it fractures into light needles and escapes into depth.
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 11.0
local kArrivalDuration = 1.35
local kArrivalStaggerSpan = 0.55
local kArrivalDepth = 0.85
local kArrivalArcDegrees = 220.0
local kArrivalRadialDistance = 0.48
local kPulseStart =
    kArrivalDuration + kArrivalStaggerSpan + 0.05
local kPulsePeriod = 1.8
local kPulseAfterglowDuration = 0.35
local kPulsePauseDuration = 0.55
local kIntroStart =
    kPulseStart +
    kPulsePeriod +
    kPulseAfterglowDuration +
    kPulsePauseDuration
local kIntroDuration = 1.3
local kIntroStaggerSpan = 0.45
local kIntroScaleSettleDuration = 0.8
local kIntroFadeDuration = 0.32
local kMinimumTextHoldDuration = 1.7
local kOutroLeadTime = 2.15
local kOutroDuration = 1.15
local kOutroStaggerSpan = 0.42
local kOutroFadeDuration = 0.48

local kLoopCenterX = 0.5
local kLoopCenterY = 0.5
local kLoopRadius = 0.275
local kLeafLengthUnits = 1320.0
local kLeafHalfWidthUnits = 172.0
local kLeafOverlap = 1.08
local kLeafVeinGapRatio = 0.065
local kLeafCenterSkewRatio = 0.1
local kLeafUpperFullness = 0.96
local kLeafLowerFullness = 0.82
local kLeafFullnessVariation = 0.08
local kLeafUpperTrailingControlRatio = 0.58
local kLeafUpperLeadingControlRatio = 0.2
local kLeafUpperTrailingHeightRatio = 0.82
local kLeafLowerTrailingControlRatio = 0.52
local kLeafLowerLeadingControlRatio = 0.28
local kLeafLowerTrailingHeightRatio = 0.68
local kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio = 0.42
local kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio = 0.36
local kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio = 0.26
local kPathUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kMinimumLeafScale = 0.28
local kMaximumLeafScale = 1.35
local kMinimumScale = 0.0001
local kEdgeOnYaw = 90.0
local kHalfTurnDegrees = 180.0
local kFullTurnDegrees = 360.0

local kPulseRadius = 0.105
local kPulseTrailOffset = 0.13
local kPulseTrailRadius = 0.18
local kPulseTrailStrength = 0.38
local kPulseWidthBoost = 0.42
local kPulseDepthLift = 0.035
local kIdleBreathAmount = 0.018
local kIdleBreathFrequency = 0.21
local kShardLengthUnits = 1180.0
local kShardHalfWidthUnits = 72.0
local kShardLaunchDistance = 0.52
local kShardDepth = 0.72
local kShardPositionFanDegrees = 22.0
local kShardDirectionJitterDegrees = 35.0
local kShardMinimumSpeedScale = 0.76
local kShardMaximumSpeedScale = 1.28
local kShardDirectionSeedOffset = 113
local kShardSpeedSeedOffset = 197
local kShardTailEndRatio = 0.62
local kShardShoulderRatio = 0.18
local kShardTailNotchUnits = 115.0
local kShardAfterimageLengthUnits = 220.0
local kShardAfterimageCount = 2
local kShardAfterimageLengthDecay = 0.72
local kShardAfterimageBaseGapUnits = 90.0
local kShardAfterimageTravelGapUnits = 150.0
local kShardAfterimageHeightRatio = 0.28
local kShardAfterimageVerticalOffsetRatio = 0.42
local kShardAfterimageSlantUnits = 32.0
local kGlitchPulseCount = 3
local kGlitchPulseSpacing = 0.105
local kGlitchPulseDuration = 0.09
local kGlitchFalloffRadiusRatio = 0.42
local kGlitchBurstPeriod = 0.94
local kGlitchTimingJitter = 0.028
local kGlitchActivationChance = 0.42
local kGlitchMinimumStrength = 0.68
local kGlitchCharacterSeedStride = 4099
local kGlitchEventSeedStride = 131
local kGlitchTimingSeedOffset = 17
local kGlitchActivationSeedOffset = 43
local kGlitchStrengthSeedOffset = 79
local kGlitchBlockCount = 5
local kGlitchBlockHeightUnits = 96.0
local kGlitchBlockVerticalStepUnits = 155.0
local kGlitchBlockBaseWidthUnits = 300.0
local kGlitchBlockWidthStepUnits = 90.0
local kGlitchOffset = 0.008

local kCameraPerspective = 0.28
local kCameraYawAmplitude = 13.0
local kCameraPitch = 8.0
local kCameraZoom = 1.04

local kPearlColor = { r = 0.82, g = 0.87, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }
local kLeafColor = { r = 0.12, g = 0.32, b = 0.72, a = 1.0 }
local kPulseColor = { r = 0.68, g = 1.0, b = 0.94, a = 1.0 }
local kGlitchColorA = { r = 0.2, g = 0.95, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kGlitchColorB = { r = 1.0, g = 0.22, b = 0.74, a = 1.0 }
local kEdgeColor = { r = 0.04, g = 0.08, b = 0.22, a = 0.96 }
local kStrokeWidth = 0.008

local kPathModeLeaf = "leaf"
local kPathModeShard = "shard"
local kPathModeGlitch = "glitch"

local cachedPathMode = {}
local cachedPathWidth = {}
local cachedPathBend = {}
local cachedPathProgress = {}

local function getOutroStart(ctx)
    return math.max(
        kIntroStart + kIntroDuration + kIntroStaggerSpan +
            kMinimumTextHoldDuration,
        mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength) - kOutroLeadTime)
end

local function getCircularDistance(firstPosition, secondPosition)
    local directDistance = math.abs(firstPosition - secondPosition)
    return math.min(directDistance, 1.0 - directDistance)
end

local function getStaggerProgress(
        time,
        ordinal,
        characterCount,
        pattern,
        totalSpan,
        duration)
    local perCharacterDelay =
        totalSpan / math.max(characterCount - 1, 1)
    local progress = mt.stagger_pattern(
        time,
        ordinal,
        characterCount,
        pattern,
        perCharacterDelay,
        duration)
    return mt.smoothstep(
        0.0,
        1.0,
        progress)
end

local function getGlitchEvent(ctx, ordinal, outroStart)
    local textHoldStart =
        kIntroStart + kIntroDuration + kIntroStaggerSpan + 0.18
    local textHoldEnd = outroStart - 0.22
    local glitchAmount = 0.0
    local glitchEventIndex = 0

    if ctx.time >= textHoldStart and ctx.time < textHoldEnd then
        local rhythmTime = ctx.time - textHoldStart
        local currentBurstIndex =
            math.floor(rhythmTime / kGlitchBurstPeriod)

        for burstOffset = -1, 1 do
            local burstIndex = currentBurstIndex + burstOffset
            if burstIndex >= 0 then
                for pulseIndex = 0, kGlitchPulseCount - 1 do
                    local eventIndex =
                        burstIndex * kGlitchPulseCount + pulseIndex
                    local randomIndex =
                        ordinal * kGlitchCharacterSeedStride +
                        eventIndex * kGlitchEventSeedStride
                    local selectedCharacter =
                        mt.random(
                            ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                kGlitchActivationSeedOffset,
                            randomIndex) < kGlitchActivationChance

                    if selectedCharacter then
                        local timingOffset =
                            mt.random_range(
                                ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                    kGlitchTimingSeedOffset,
                                randomIndex,
                                -kGlitchTimingJitter,
                                kGlitchTimingJitter)
                        local eventTime =
                            textHoldStart +
                            burstIndex * kGlitchBurstPeriod +
                            pulseIndex * kGlitchPulseSpacing +
                            timingOffset
                        local eventDistance =
                            math.abs(ctx.time - eventTime)

                        if eventDistance <=
                            kGlitchPulseDuration * 0.5 then
                            local eventStrength =
                                mt.random_range(
                                    ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                        kGlitchStrengthSeedOffset,
                                    randomIndex,
                                    kGlitchMinimumStrength,
                                    1.0)
                            local candidateAmount =
                                mt.falloff(
                                    eventDistance,
                                    kGlitchPulseDuration *
                                        kGlitchFalloffRadiusRatio) *
                                eventStrength
                            if candidateAmount > glitchAmount then
                                glitchAmount = candidateAmount
                                glitchEventIndex = eventIndex + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return glitchAmount, glitchEventIndex
end

local function getFoldTransforms(segmentState, targetRotation, targetPitch)
    local yaw = 0.0
    local rotation = 0.0
    local pitch = 0.0

    if segmentState < 0.5 then
        local foldProgress = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, segmentState * 2.0)
        yaw = mt.lerp(0.0, kEdgeOnYaw, foldProgress)
    else
        local unfoldProgress =
            mt.smoothstep(
                0.0,
                1.0,
                (segmentState - 0.5) * 2.0)
        yaw = mt.lerp(kEdgeOnYaw, 0.0, unfoldProgress)
        rotation = targetRotation * unfoldProgress
        pitch = targetPitch * unfoldProgress
    end

    return yaw, rotation, pitch
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local clipLength = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local inspectorGlobalScale = ctx.global.scale
    local introScaleReleaseStart =
        kIntroStart + kIntroStaggerSpan + kIntroDuration * 0.5
    local introScaleReleaseEnd =
        kIntroStart +
        kIntroDuration +
        kIntroStaggerSpan +
        kIntroScaleSettleDuration
    local introScaleReleaseProgress = mt.saturate(
        mt.inverse_lerp(
            introScaleReleaseStart,
            introScaleReleaseEnd,
            ctx.time))
    local introScaleLock =
        1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(introScaleReleaseProgress)
    local introCompletion =
        mt.smoothstep(
            kIntroStart,
            kIntroStart +
                kIntroDuration +
                kIntroStaggerSpan,
            ctx.time)
    local introLoopPresence = 1.0 - introCompletion
    local outroStart = getOutroStart(ctx)
    local outroScaleLockStart =
        outroStart + kOutroStaggerSpan + kOutroDuration * 0.5
    local outroScaleLockEnd =
        outroStart + kOutroStaggerSpan + kOutroDuration
    local outroScaleLock = mt.smoothstep(
        outroScaleLockStart,
        outroScaleLockEnd,
        ctx.time)
    local generatedScaleLock =
        math.max(introScaleLock, outroScaleLock)
    local outroPresence =
        mt.smoothstep(
            outroStart,
            outroStart +
                kOutroDuration +
                kOutroStaggerSpan,
            ctx.time)
    local introVisibility =
        mt.smoothstep(0.0, kIntroFadeDuration, ctx.time)
    local outroVisibility = 1.0 - mt.smoothstep(
        clipLength - kOutroFadeDuration,
        clipLength,
        ctx.time)

    ctx.camera.yaw =
        mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.115, 0.0) *
            kCameraYawAmplitude * introLoopPresence -
        outroPresence * 7.0
    ctx.camera.pitch =
        kCameraPitch * introLoopPresence - outroPresence * 4.0
    ctx.camera.perspective =
        kCameraPerspective * math.max(introLoopPresence, outroPresence)
    ctx.camera.zoom =
        mt.lerp(1.0, kCameraZoom, introLoopPresence) -
        outroPresence * 0.06
    ctx.global.scale =
        mt.lerp(inspectorGlobalScale, 1.0, generatedScaleLock)
    ctx.global.opacity =
        ctx.global.opacity * introVisibility * outroVisibility
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    cachedPathMode = {}
    cachedPathWidth = {}
    cachedPathBend = {}
    cachedPathProgress = {}

    local leafCharacterCount = 0
    local ordinalByCharacter = {}
    for characterIndex, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if character.part_count > 0 then
            leafCharacterCount = leafCharacterCount + 1
            ordinalByCharacter[characterIndex] = leafCharacterCount
        end
    end

    local emCanvasHeight = math.max(
        ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent,
        0.001)
    local angleStep = kFullTurnDegrees / math.max(leafCharacterCount, 1)
    local chordLength =
        2.0 * kLoopRadius *
        math.sin(math.rad(angleStep) * 0.5) *
        kLeafOverlap
    local targetLeafScale = mt.clamp(
        chordLength / (emCanvasHeight * kLeafLengthUnits / kPathUnitsPerEm),
        kMinimumLeafScale,
        kMaximumLeafScale)
    local pulseProgress = mt.saturate(
        mt.inverse_lerp(
            kPulseStart,
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod,
            ctx.time))
    local pulseVisibility =
        mt.smoothstep(kPulseStart, kPulseStart + 0.12, ctx.time) *
        (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod,
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod +
                kPulseAfterglowDuration,
            ctx.time))
    local pulsePosition = pulseProgress
    local pulseTrailPosition =
        mt.cycle(pulsePosition - kPulseTrailOffset, 1.0)
    local breathingRadius =
        kLoopRadius *
        (1.0 + mt.wave(ctx.time, kIdleBreathFrequency, 0.0) * kIdleBreathAmount)
    local outroStart = getOutroStart(ctx)

    for characterIndex, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
            local ordinal = ordinalByCharacter[characterIndex]

        if ordinal ~= nil then
            local distributedPosition =
                (ordinal - 1.0) / math.max(leafCharacterCount, 1)
            local angleDegrees = distributedPosition * kFullTurnDegrees
            local introLeafState =
                1.0 - getStaggerProgress(
                    ctx.time - kIntroStart,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "asc",
                    kIntroStaggerSpan,
                    kIntroDuration)
            local outroState =
                getStaggerProgress(
                    ctx.time - outroStart,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "desc",
                    kOutroStaggerSpan,
                    kOutroDuration)
            local arrivalProgress =
                getStaggerProgress(
                    ctx.time,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "asc",
                    kArrivalStaggerSpan,
                    kArrivalDuration)
            local naturalCanvasX, naturalCanvasY =
                mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            local pulseDistance =
                getCircularDistance(distributedPosition, pulsePosition)
            local pulseTrailDistance =
                getCircularDistance(
                    distributedPosition,
                    pulseTrailPosition)
            local pulseAmount = mt.saturate(
                mt.falloff(pulseDistance, kPulseRadius) +
                mt.falloff(pulseTrailDistance, kPulseTrailRadius) *
                    kPulseTrailStrength)
            local placedCanvasX = naturalCanvasX
            local placedCanvasY = naturalCanvasY
            local pathMode = nil
            local pathWidth = kLeafHalfWidthUnits
            local pathBend = 0.0
            local pathProgress = 0.0
            local color = kPearlColor
            local strokeColor = kEdgeColor

            if outroState > 0.0 then
                local launchProgress = mt.smoothstep(
                    0.5,
                    1.0,
                    outroState)
                local directionJitter =
                    mt.random_range(
                        ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                            kShardDirectionSeedOffset,
                        ordinal,
                        -kShardDirectionJitterDegrees,
                        kShardDirectionJitterDegrees)
                local speedScale =
                    mt.random_range(
                        ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                            kShardSpeedSeedOffset,
                        ordinal,
                        kShardMinimumSpeedScale,
                        kShardMaximumSpeedScale)
                local launchAngle =
                    -90.0 +
                    (distributedPosition - 0.5) *
                        kShardPositionFanDegrees +
                    directionJitter
                local launchDistance =
                    launchProgress *
                    kShardLaunchDistance *
                    speedScale
                local launchOffsetX, launchOffsetY =
                    mt.polar_offset_2d(
                        launchAngle,
                        launchDistance)
                placedCanvasX = naturalCanvasX + launchOffsetX
                placedCanvasY = naturalCanvasY + launchOffsetY

                local yaw, rotation, pitch =
                    getFoldTransforms(
                        outroState,
                        launchAngle,
                        -28.0 + distributedPosition * 56.0)
                character.yaw = character.yaw + yaw
                character.rotation =
                    character.rotation +
                    rotation
                character.pitch = character.pitch + pitch
                character.z =
                    character.z +
                    launchProgress *
                        kShardDepth *
                        speedScale
                character.scale =
                    character.scale * mt.lerp(1.0, 0.58, launchProgress)
                if outroState >= 0.5 then
                    character.scale =
                        character.scale /
                        math.max(ctx.global.scale, kMinimumScale)
                end
                character.opacity =
                    character.opacity *
                    (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.72, 1.0, outroState))

                local shardPulse =
                    mt.falloff(outroState - 0.58, 0.16)
                color =
                    mt.color.lerp(kPearlColor, kPulseColor, shardPulse)
                strokeColor =
                    mt.color.lerp(kEdgeColor, kPulseColor, shardPulse)
                pathMode =
                    outroState >= 0.5 and kPathModeShard or nil
                pathWidth =
                    kShardHalfWidthUnits * (1.0 + shardPulse * 0.7)
                pathBend =
                    (distributedPosition - 0.5) * 0.3
                pathProgress =
                    mt.saturate(launchProgress * speedScale)
            else
                local arrivalAngleDegrees =
                    angleDegrees -
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) * kArrivalArcDegrees
                local arrivalAngleRadians =
                    math.rad(arrivalAngleDegrees)
                local arrivalRadius =
                    breathingRadius +
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalRadialDistance
                local arrivalCanvasX =
                    kLoopCenterX +
                    math.cos(arrivalAngleRadians) * arrivalRadius /
                        (ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio *
                            ctx.canvas.pixel_aspect_ratio)
                local arrivalCanvasY =
                    kLoopCenterY +
                    math.sin(arrivalAngleRadians) * arrivalRadius
                placedCanvasX =
                    mt.lerp(
                        naturalCanvasX,
                        arrivalCanvasX,
                        introLeafState)
                placedCanvasY =
                    mt.lerp(
                        naturalCanvasY,
                        arrivalCanvasY,
                        introLeafState)

                local targetRotation =
                    -(arrivalAngleDegrees + 90.0)
                local targetPitch =
                    distributedPosition * kHalfTurnDegrees -
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalArcDegrees * 0.5
                local yaw, rotation, pitch =
                    getFoldTransforms(
                        introLeafState,
                        targetRotation,
                        targetPitch)
                character.yaw = character.yaw + yaw
                character.rotation =
                    character.rotation + rotation
                character.pitch = character.pitch + pitch
                character.z =
                    character.z +
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalDepth *
                        introLeafState
                character.scale =
                    character.scale *
                    mt.lerp(
                        1.0,
                        targetLeafScale,
                        introLeafState) *
                    mt.lerp(0.32, 1.0, arrivalProgress)
                character.opacity =
                    character.opacity *
                    mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.45, arrivalProgress)

                local visiblePulse =
                    pulseAmount *
                    pulseVisibility *
                    introLeafState *
                    arrivalProgress
                character.z =
                    character.z - visiblePulse * kPulseDepthLift
                color = mt.color.lerp(
                    mt.color.lerp(
                        kPearlColor,
                        kLeafColor,
                        introLeafState),
                    kPulseColor,
                    visiblePulse)
                strokeColor =
                    mt.color.lerp(
                        kEdgeColor,
                        kPulseColor,
                        visiblePulse * 0.7)
                pathMode =
                    introLeafState >= 0.5 and kPathModeLeaf or nil
                pathWidth =
                    kLeafHalfWidthUnits *
                    (1.0 + visiblePulse * kPulseWidthBoost)
                pathBend =
                    mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.38, distributedPosition) *
                    (0.08 + visiblePulse * 0.14)

                local glitchAmount, glitchEventIndex =
                    getGlitchEvent(ctx, ordinal, outroStart)
                if introLeafState < 0.5 and
                    glitchEventIndex > 0 then
                    local glitchDirection =
                        (ordinal + glitchEventIndex) % 2 == 0 and
                        1.0 or -1.0
                    placedCanvasX =
                        placedCanvasX +
                        glitchDirection *
                            kGlitchOffset * glitchAmount
                    placedCanvasY =
                        placedCanvasY +
                        ((glitchEventIndex - 1) %
                            kGlitchPulseCount - 1.0) *
                            kGlitchOffset * 0.35 *
                            glitchAmount
                    character.stretch_x =
                        character.stretch_x *
                        (1.0 + glitchAmount * 0.18)
                    character.stretch_y =
                        character.stretch_y *
                        (1.0 - glitchAmount * 0.12)
                    color = mt.color.lerp(
                        kPearlColor,
                        glitchEventIndex % 2 == 0 and
                            kGlitchColorA or kGlitchColorB,
                        glitchAmount)
                    strokeColor =
                        mt.color.lerp(
                            kEdgeColor,
                            kPulseColor,
                            glitchAmount)
                    pathMode = kPathModeGlitch
                    pathWidth = glitchAmount
                    pathBend = glitchEventIndex
                end
            end

            mt.layout.place_2d(
                ctx,
                character,
                placedCanvasX,
                placedCanvasY)

            if pathMode ~= nil then
                local firstPart = ctx.parts[character.part_start]
                if firstPart ~= nil then
                    mt.layout.place_2d(
                        ctx,
                        firstPart,
                        placedCanvasX,
                        placedCanvasY)
                end
            end

            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = color
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
            character.stroke.gap = 0.0
            character.stroke.color = strokeColor

            cachedPathMode[characterIndex] = pathMode
            cachedPathWidth[characterIndex] = pathWidth
            cachedPathBend[characterIndex] = pathBend
            cachedPathProgress[characterIndex] = pathProgress
        end
    end
end

local function appendLeafPath(path, characterIndex, halfWidth, bend)
    local halfLength = kLeafLengthUnits * 0.5
    local leafDirection =
        characterIndex % 2 == 0 and -1.0 or 1.0
    local centerY =
        halfWidth * kLeafCenterSkewRatio * leafDirection
    local veinGap = halfWidth * kLeafVeinGapRatio
    local upperWidth =
        halfWidth *
        (kLeafUpperFullness -
            leafDirection * kLeafFullnessVariation) *
        (1.0 + bend)
    local lowerWidth =
        halfWidth *
        (kLeafLowerFullness +
            leafDirection * kLeafFullnessVariation) *
        (1.0 - bend)

    path:move_to(-halfLength, centerY - veinGap)
    path:cubic_to(
        -halfLength * kLeafUpperTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY - upperWidth * kLeafUpperTrailingHeightRatio,
        halfLength * kLeafUpperLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY - upperWidth,
        halfLength,
        centerY)
    path:cubic_to(
        halfLength * kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY - veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength * kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY - veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength,
        centerY - veinGap)
    path:close()

    path:move_to(-halfLength, centerY + veinGap)
    path:cubic_to(
        -halfLength * kLeafLowerTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY + lowerWidth * kLeafLowerTrailingHeightRatio,
        halfLength * kLeafLowerLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY + lowerWidth,
        halfLength,
        centerY)
    path:cubic_to(
        halfLength * kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY + veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength * kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY + veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength,
        centerY + veinGap)
    path:close()
end

local function appendShardPath(path, halfWidth, bend, progress)
    local halfLength = kShardLengthUnits * 0.5
    local noseX = halfLength
    local shoulderX = halfLength * kShardShoulderRatio
    local tailEndX = -halfLength * kShardTailEndRatio
    local tailCenterY = bend * halfWidth
    local tailHalfWidth = halfWidth * 0.36

    path:move_to(noseX, 0.0)
    path:cubic_to(
        shoulderX,
        -halfWidth,
        -shoulderX,
        -halfWidth * 0.72,
        tailEndX,
        tailCenterY - tailHalfWidth)
    path:line_to(
        tailEndX + kShardTailNotchUnits,
        tailCenterY)
    path:line_to(tailEndX, tailCenterY + tailHalfWidth)
    path:cubic_to(
        -shoulderX,
        halfWidth * 0.72,
        shoulderX,
        halfWidth,
        noseX,
        0.0)
    path:close()

    local afterimageGap =
        kShardAfterimageBaseGapUnits +
        progress * kShardAfterimageTravelGapUnits
    local previousLeftX = tailEndX
    for afterimageIndex = 1, kShardAfterimageCount do
        local afterimageLength =
            kShardAfterimageLengthUnits *
            kShardAfterimageLengthDecay ^ (afterimageIndex - 1)
        local afterimageRightX = previousLeftX - afterimageGap
        local afterimageLeftX =
            afterimageRightX - afterimageLength
        local verticalDirection =
            afterimageIndex % 2 == 0 and -1.0 or 1.0
        local afterimageCenterY =
            tailCenterY +
            verticalDirection *
                halfWidth *
                kShardAfterimageVerticalOffsetRatio
        local afterimageHalfHeight =
            halfWidth * kShardAfterimageHeightRatio
        local afterimageSlant =
            kShardAfterimageSlantUnits * verticalDirection

        path:move_to(
            afterimageLeftX - afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY - afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageRightX - afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY - afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageRightX + afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY + afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageLeftX + afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY + afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:close()
        previousLeftX = afterimageLeftX
    end
end

local function appendGlitchPath(
        path,
        characterIndex,
        glitchAmount,
        glitchEventIndex)
    for blockIndex = 1, kGlitchBlockCount do
        local widthStep =
            (characterIndex * 3 +
                blockIndex * 2 +
                glitchEventIndex) % 4
        local blockWidth =
            kGlitchBlockBaseWidthUnits +
            widthStep * kGlitchBlockWidthStepUnits
        local blockHalfWidth = blockWidth * 0.5
        local blockHalfHeight =
            kGlitchBlockHeightUnits *
            (0.7 + glitchAmount * 0.3) * 0.5
        local blockCenterX =
            math.sin(
                characterIndex * 1.7 +
                blockIndex * 2.1 +
                glitchEventIndex) *
            170.0 * glitchAmount
        local blockCenterY =
            (blockIndex -
                (kGlitchBlockCount + 1.0) * 0.5) *
            kGlitchBlockVerticalStepUnits

        path:move_to(
            blockCenterX - blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY - blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX + blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY - blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX + blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY + blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX - blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY + blockHalfHeight)
        path:close()
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for characterIndex = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local pathMode = cachedPathMode[characterIndex]
        if pathMode ~= nil then
            local pathParts = ctx.paths:character(characterIndex)

            if #pathParts > 0 then
                local halfWidth =
                    cachedPathWidth[characterIndex] or kLeafHalfWidthUnits
                local bend = cachedPathBend[characterIndex] or 0.0
                local pathProgress =
                    cachedPathProgress[characterIndex] or 0.0
                local generatedPath = pathParts[1].path

                generatedPath:clear()
                if pathMode == kPathModeLeaf then
                    appendLeafPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        characterIndex,
                        halfWidth,
                        bend)
                elseif pathMode == kPathModeShard then
                    appendShardPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        halfWidth,
                        bend,
                        pathProgress)
                elseif pathMode == kPathModeGlitch then
                    appendGlitchPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        characterIndex,
                        halfWidth,
                        math.floor(bend))
                end

                for partIndex = 2, #pathParts do
                    pathParts[partIndex].path:clear()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
description:
Mobius transmission. Luminous fragments spiral in from deep space and
lock into a one-sided receiver. A signal circles the completed loop,
lingers, then decodes into readable text through an invisible edge-on
exchange. Sparse block interference interrupts the held message before
it fractures into light needles and escapes into depth.
title: Mobius Transmission
author: Mug

name: 67_chromatic_rift.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 7.2
-- @recommend text "CHROMA//RIFT"
-- @recommend bg #03020B
-- @title Chromatic Rift
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 7
--[[ @description
Three misregistered color shells slam together into a double-stroke
emblem. A chromatic fracture tears its gap open, then stitches itself
from both edges while drawing every remaining trace of color to its core.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.05
local kOutroDuration = 1.35
local kFallbackClipLength = 7.2
local kIntroStagger = 0.5
local kOutroStagger = 0.62
local kRiftSpeed = 3.0
local kRiftSpread = 8.5
local kMaximumGap = 0.046
local kInnerWidth = 0.026
local kInnerImpactWidth = 0.016
local kOuterWidth = 0.043
local kOuterAfterglowWidth = 0.022
local kAssemblyGap = 0.058
local kSutureGap = 0.062

local function bell(value, center, width)
    local distance = (value - center) / width
    return math.exp(-distance * distance)
end

local function withAlpha(color, alpha)
    return { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = alpha }
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local globalBreath = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(ctx.time * 1.35)

    ctx.global.rotation = ctx.global.rotation + math.sin(ctx.time * 0.72) * 1.2
    ctx.global.scale = ctx.global.scale * (1.0 + globalBreath * 0.018)

    ctx.global.stroke.order = "fill_over_stroke"
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "round"
    ctx.global.stroke.miter_limit = 4.0

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 2.0 + globalBreath * 1.6
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 304.0 + math.sin(ctx.time * 0.9) * 14.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.01, g = 0.0, b = 0.05, a = 0.82 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    -- This effect is deliberately 2D-only. Do not copy this override merely as
    -- an optimization: it makes every Inspector and keyframed 3D setting inert.
    ctx.output.force_disable_3d_projection = true

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress
        local inspectorOffsetX = character.offset_x
        local inspectorOffsetY = character.offset_y
        local inspectorRotation = character.rotation
        local inspectorScale = character.scale
        local inspectorStretchX = character.stretch_x
        local inspectorStretchY = character.stretch_y
        local inspectorOpacity = character.opacity
        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kIntroStagger)
        local centerProximity = 1.0 - math.abs(order * 2.0 - 1.0)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, centerProximity, kOutroStagger)
        local shellArrival = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.25, introRaw)
        local innerArrival = mt.smoothstep(0.12, 0.5, introRaw)
        local fillArrival = mt.smoothstep(0.32, 0.72, introRaw)
        local arrivalProgress = mt.ease.out_back(mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.72, introRaw))
        local registrationLock = mt.smoothstep(0.52, 0.82, introRaw)
        local registrationImpact = bell(introRaw, 0.78, 0.095)

        local sutureWake = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.16, outroAmount)
        local stitched = mt.smoothstep(0.12, 0.62, outroRaw)
        local colorDrain = mt.smoothstep(0.34, 0.78, outroRaw)
        local sutureFlash = bell(outroRaw, 0.5, 0.11)
        local convergence = centerProximity ^ 6.0 * bell(outroRaw, 0.72, 0.15)
        local terminalFade = 1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.8, 1.0, outroRaw)

        -- The negative half of the carrier deliberately stays at exactly
        -- zero, giving the emblem a fully sealed state between fractures.
        local phase = ctx.time * kRiftSpeed - order * kRiftSpread
        local carrier = math.sin(phase)
        local opening = math.max(0.0, carrier)
        local gapEnergy = opening * opening * (3.0 - 2.0 * opening)

        -- A delayed, wider lobe makes the outer shell keep glowing after
        -- the gap itself starts closing.
        local afterglowCarrier = math.sin(phase - 0.72)
        local afterglow = math.max(0.0, afterglowCarrier)
        afterglow = afterglow * afterglow
        local impact = mt.smoothstep(0.58, 0.94, gapEnergy)
        local riftImpact = impact * (1.0 - stitched)
        local riftAfterglow = afterglow * (1.0 - stitched)
        local settledWeight = registrationLock * (1.0 - stitched)
        local riftGap = kMaximumGap * gapEnergy * settledWeight
        local assemblyGap = kAssemblyGap * shellArrival * (1.0 - registrationLock)
        local sutureGap = kSutureGap * sutureWake * (1.0 - stitched)
        local activeGap = math.max(riftGap, assemblyGap, sutureGap)

        local side = order * 2.0 - 1.0
        local verticalSign = ((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local idleTilt = math.sin(ctx.time * 1.7 + order * math.pi * 2.0)
        local entryDistance = 1.0 - arrivalProgress
        local entryOffsetX = side * entryDistance * 0.24
        local entryOffsetY = verticalSign * entryDistance * 0.13
        local riftOffsetX = side * riftGap * 0.32
        local riftOffsetY = verticalSign * riftGap * 0.4 + riftAfterglow * 0.006
        local registrationPull = -side * stitched * 0.009

        character.offset_x = inspectorOffsetX + entryOffsetX + riftOffsetX + registrationPull
        character.offset_y = inspectorOffsetY + entryOffsetY + riftOffsetY
        character.rotation = inspectorRotation
            + verticalSign * entryDistance * 62.0
            + idleTilt * 1.5 * registrationLock * (1.0 - stitched)
            + verticalSign * riftImpact * 5.5
        character.scale = inspectorScale
            * (0.2 + arrivalProgress * 0.8)
            * (1.0 + registrationImpact * 0.17 + riftImpact * 0.1
                + sutureFlash * 0.035 + convergence * 0.16)
        character.stretch_x = inspectorStretchX
            * (1.0 + riftGap * 1.05 - sutureFlash * 0.025)
        character.stretch_y = inspectorStretchY
            * (1.0 - riftGap * 0.58 + sutureFlash * 0.035)
        character.opacity = inspectorOpacity * shellArrival * terminalFade

        local hue = mt.cycle(ctx.time * 0.13 + order * 0.68, 1.0)
        local calmFill = mt.color.from_oklch(0.94, 0.035, hue + 0.12, 1.0)
        local impactFill = mt.color.from_oklch(0.98, 0.11, hue + 0.2, 1.0)
        local innerCalm = mt.color.from_oklch(0.72, 0.2, hue, 1.0)
        local innerImpact = mt.color.from_oklch(0.86, 0.27, hue + 0.16, 1.0)
        local outerCalm = mt.color.from_oklch(0.34, 0.18, hue + 0.54, 1.0)
        local outerHot = mt.color.from_oklch(0.68, 0.3, hue + 0.43, 1.0)
        local sealedFill = { r = 0.055, g = 0.05, b = 0.08, a = 1.0 }
        local sealedInner = { r = 0.11, g = 0.1, b = 0.15, a = 1.0 }
        local sealedOuter = { r = 0.025, g = 0.02, b = 0.045, a = 1.0 }
        local convergenceWhite = { r = 1.0, g = 0.98, b = 0.9, a = 1.0 }

        local fillAlpha = fillArrival * (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.62, 0.88, outroRaw))
        local innerAlpha = innerArrival * (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.7, 0.94, outroRaw))
        local outerAlpha = shellArrival * terminalFade
        local introWhiteFlash = registrationImpact * (1.0 - outroRaw)
        local outroGlow = math.max(sutureFlash, convergence)

        local fillColor = mt.color.lerp(calmFill, impactFill, math.max(riftImpact, introWhiteFlash))
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, sealedFill, colorDrain)
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, convergenceWhite, convergence)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = withAlpha(fillColor, fillAlpha)

        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width =
            kInnerWidth + kInnerImpactWidth * math.max(riftImpact, registrationImpact)
        character.stroke.gap = activeGap
        character.stroke.color = withAlpha(
            mt.color.lerp(
                mt.color.lerp(innerCalm, innerImpact, math.max(riftImpact, introWhiteFlash)),
                sealedInner,
                colorDrain * (1.0 - convergence)),
            innerAlpha)
        character.stroke.outer_width =
            kOuterWidth
            + kOuterAfterglowWidth * math.max(riftAfterglow, registrationImpact)
            + outroGlow * 0.03
        character.stroke.outer_color = withAlpha(
            mt.color.lerp(
                mt.color.lerp(
                    outerCalm,
                    outerHot,
                    mt.saturate(riftImpact + riftAfterglow * 0.75 + registrationImpact + outroGlow)),
                sealedOuter,
                colorDrain * (1.0 - convergence)),
            outerAlpha)

        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = mt.color.from_oklch(
            0.46,
            0.25,
            hue + 0.48,
            (0.22 + riftImpact * 0.52 + registrationImpact * 0.26 + outroGlow * 0.4)
                * outerAlpha)
    end
end
description:
Three misregistered color shells slam together into a double-stroke
emblem. A chromatic fracture tears its gap open, then stitches itself
from both edges while drawing every remaining trace of color to its core.

-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 9.0
-- @recommend text "弾幕スタンバイ"
-- @recommend bg #080A12
-- @title Danmaku Overdrive
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 7
--[[ @description
A dense live-comment barrage fills twelve lanes with flowing, fixed,
and highlighted messages. More than 128 glyphs remain individually
positioned while the comment density ebbs and periodically surges.
]]

local kComments = {
    "うぽつです",
    "きたああああああ",
    "初見ですよろしく",
    "ここすき",
    "その発想はなかった",
    "職人すごすぎる",
    "8888888888888888",
    "！？！？！？！？",
    "なぜ止めたし",
    "かわいいいいいい",
    "これは伸びる",
    "伝説の始まり",
    "待ってました",
    "音ハメ気持ちいい",
    "弾幕薄いよ何やってんの",
    "画面が見えない",
    "コメントで完成する動画",
    "すでにカオス",
    "右から来るぞ気をつけろ",
    "左からも来た",
    "色コメ助かる",
    "ここから本番",
    "まだ半分だと",
    "密度がおかしい",
    "88888888888888888888",
    "神回確定",
    "タイミング完璧",
    "何度でも見たい",
    "これぞ弾幕",
    "みんな落ち着け",
    "無理です",
    "加速してる",
    "目が足りない",
    "一時停止推奨",
    "止めても動くぞ",
    "最後まで見逃すな",
    "ここにいた証を残す",
    "未来の自分へ",
    "またこの場所で",
    "ご視聴ありがとうございました",
}

local kSponsorComments = {
    "この動画は",
    "ご覧のスポンサーの提供で",
    "お送りしました",
}

local kTuning = {
    baseline_density = 0.34, -- Fraction of comments used by the continuous stream.
    burst_density = 1.0, -- Fraction of comments used at the density peak.
    text_scale = 1.0, -- Shared multiplier for small, medium, and big comments.
    travel_speed = 1.0, -- 1.2 is 20% faster; 0.8 is 20% slower.
}

local kLaneCount = 12
local kFallbackClipLength = 9.0
local kIntroDuration = 1.2
local kIntroInitialDelay = 0.1
local kTravelPeriod = 3.8
local kBurstInitialDelay = 3.4
local kBurstInterval = 7.6
local kBurstSpreadDuration = 0.28
local kFinalBarrageClearance = 0.08
local kFixedInitialDelay = 0.45
local kFixedDisplayDuration = 2.5
local kFixedGapDuration = 0.3
local kSponsorDisplayDuration = 1.6
local kSmallCommentScale = 0.25
local kMediumCommentScale = 0.33
local kBigCommentScale = 0.44
local kInnerStrokeWidth = 0.018

local function lineBounds(items)
    local left = math.huge
    local right = -math.huge
    local bottom = math.huge
    local top = -math.huge

    for _, character in ipairs(items) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local centerX = geometry.bounds_center_x + character.offset_x - 0.5
        local centerY = geometry.bounds_center_y + character.offset_y - 0.5
        local halfWidth = geometry.bounds_width * math.abs(character.scale * character.stretch_x) * 0.5
        local halfHeight = geometry.bounds_height * math.abs(character.scale * character.stretch_y) * 0.5
        left = math.min(left, centerX - halfWidth)
        right = math.max(right, centerX + halfWidth)
        bottom = math.min(bottom, centerY - halfHeight)
        top = math.max(top, centerY + halfHeight)
    end

    return {
        center_x = (left + right) * 0.5,
        center_y = (bottom + top) * 0.5,
        width = right - left,
    }
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(kComments, "\n") .. "\n" .. table.concat(kSponsorComments, "\n")
    ctx.global.stroke.order = "fill_over_stroke"
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "round"
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    -- The barrage is deliberately 2D-only. This keeps hundreds of animated
    -- characters off the projection path and makes that choice explicit.
    ctx.output.force_disable_3d_projection = true

    local lines = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    local remainingSeconds = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local clipDuration = ctx.time + remainingSeconds
    local baselineDensity = mt.saturate(kTuning.baseline_density)
    local burstDensity = math.max(baselineDensity, mt.saturate(kTuning.burst_density))
    local textScale = math.max(kTuning.text_scale, 0.001)
    local travelSpeed = math.max(kTuning.travel_speed, 0.001)
    for lineOrder, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local sponsorLineOrder = lineOrder - #kComments
        local isSponsor = sponsorLineOrder > 0
        local lineProgress = mt.distribute(math.min(lineOrder, #kComments), math.max(#kComments, 1))
        local laneIndex = ((lineOrder - 1) * 7) % kLaneCount
        local isFixed = not isSponsor and lineOrder % 10 == 0
        local isHighlighted = not isSponsor
            and (lineOrder % 6 == 0 or string.find(kComments[lineOrder] or "", "888", 1, true) ~= nil)
        local isSmall = lineOrder % 7 == 2 or lineOrder % 11 == 0
        local baseScale = kMediumCommentScale
        if isSponsor and sponsorLineOrder == 2 then
            baseScale = kBigCommentScale
        elseif isHighlighted then
            baseScale = kBigCommentScale
        elseif isSmall then
            baseScale = kSmallCommentScale
        end
        local lineIndices = {}

        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            table.insert(lineIndices, character.index)
            character.scale = character.scale * baseScale * textScale

            local hue = mt.cycle(lineProgress * 1.73, 1.0)
            local fillColor = isHighlighted
                and mt.color.from_oklch(0.88, 0.24, hue, 1.0)
                or { r = 0.96, g = 0.97, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }

            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = fillColor
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = kInnerStrokeWidth
            character.stroke.gap = 0.0
            character.stroke.color = { r = 0.015, g = 0.018, b = 0.035, a = 0.96 }
            character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0
            character.shadow.use = false
        end

        if #lineIndices > 0 then
            mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
                targets = lineIndices,
                anchor = lineIndices[1],
            })
        end

        local bounds = lineBounds(line.items)
        local targetCenterX = 0.5
        local targetCenterY = 0.12 + (laneIndex / math.max(kLaneCount - 1, 1)) * 0.76
        local spawnDelay = kIntroInitialDelay + lineProgress * kIntroDuration
        local elapsedSinceSpawn = math.max(ctx.time - spawnDelay, 0.0)
        local visibility = ctx.time >= spawnDelay and 1.0 or 0.0
        local startX = 1.12 + bounds.width * 0.5

        if isSponsor then
            targetCenterX = 0.5
            targetCenterY = 0.58 - (sponsorLineOrder - 1) * 0.08
            visibility = remainingSeconds <= kSponsorDisplayDuration and 1.0 or 0.0
        elseif isFixed then
            local fixedOrder = math.floor(lineOrder / 10)
            local fixedSequenceIndex = math.floor((fixedOrder - 1) / 2)
            local fixedStartTime = kFixedInitialDelay
                + fixedSequenceIndex * (kFixedDisplayDuration + kFixedGapDuration)
            local fixedEndTime = fixedStartTime + kFixedDisplayDuration
            targetCenterX = 0.5
            targetCenterY = (lineOrder % 20 == 0) and 0.14 or 0.86
            visibility = ctx.time >= fixedStartTime
                and ctx.time < fixedEndTime
                and remainingSeconds > kSponsorDisplayDuration
                and 1.0
                or 0.0
        else
            local densityRank = mt.cycle(lineProgress * 2.618, 1.0)
            local nominalTravelPeriod = (3.5 + (lineOrder % 7) * 0.31) / travelSpeed
            local finalExitTime = clipDuration - kFinalBarrageClearance
            local availableTravelDuration = math.max(finalExitTime - spawnDelay, 0.001)
            local baselinePassCount = math.max(
                math.ceil(availableTravelDuration / nominalTravelPeriod),
                1
            )
            local baselineTravelPeriod = availableTravelDuration / baselinePassCount
            local travelProgress = mt.cycle(elapsedSinceSpawn, baselineTravelPeriod)

            if densityRank > baselineDensity then
                visibility = 0.0

                if densityRank <= burstDensity and burstDensity > baselineDensity then
                    local burstRank = (densityRank - baselineDensity)
                        / (burstDensity - baselineDensity)
                    local nominalBurstTravelPeriod = kTravelPeriod / travelSpeed
                    local latestBurstStartTime = finalExitTime
                        - nominalBurstTravelPeriod
                        - kBurstSpreadDuration
                    local burstBaseStartTime = math.max(
                        kIntroInitialDelay,
                        math.min(kBurstInitialDelay, latestBurstStartTime)
                    )
                    local burstTravelPeriod = math.min(
                        nominalBurstTravelPeriod,
                        math.max(finalExitTime - burstBaseStartTime - kBurstSpreadDuration, 0.001)
                    )
                    local burstStartTime = burstBaseStartTime + burstRank * kBurstSpreadDuration
                    local burstClock = ctx.time - burstStartTime
                    local isBurstActive = false

                    if burstClock >= 0.0 then
                        local burstElapsed = mt.cycle(burstClock, kBurstInterval) * kBurstInterval
                        local burstCycleIndex = math.floor(burstClock / kBurstInterval)
                        local burstCycleEndTime = burstStartTime
                            + burstCycleIndex * kBurstInterval
                            + burstTravelPeriod
                        isBurstActive = burstElapsed < burstTravelPeriod
                            and burstCycleEndTime <= finalExitTime
                        travelProgress = mt.saturate(burstElapsed / burstTravelPeriod)
                    end

                    visibility = isBurstActive and 1.0 or 0.0
                end
            end

            if ctx.time >= finalExitTime then
                travelProgress = 1.0
                visibility = 0.0
            end

            local endX = -0.12 - bounds.width * 0.5
            targetCenterX = mt.lerp(startX, endX, travelProgress)
        end

        local shiftX = targetCenterX - bounds.center_x
        local shiftY = targetCenterY - bounds.center_y

        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            character.offset_x = character.offset_x + shiftX
            character.offset_y = character.offset_y + shiftY
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        end
    end
end

A dense live-comment barrage fills twelve lanes with flowing, fixed,
and highlighted messages. More than 128 glyphs remain individually
positioned while the comment density ebbs and periodically surges.
title: Danmaku Overdrive
author: Mug
